phases.title: Diagnose and rebuild
phases.focus: Identify score gaps, refresh core skills, and establish a consistent timed practice routine.

phases.title: Targeted skill growth
phases.focus: Practice the weakest Reading and Writing and Math skills, then apply them under time limits.

phases.title: Test readiness
phases.focus: Use full-length practice tests and focused review to improve accuracy, pacing, and consistency.

phases.title: Taper
phases.focus: Keep skills fresh with brief, focused practice and avoid heavy new work.

sessionTypes.title: Baseline and error audit

blocks.activity: Complete a timed SAT practice section in each subject.
Score responses and sort errors by skill and cause.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A baseline score estimate and ranked list of skill gaps.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Both sections are scored and every missed question has an error category.

sessionTypes.title: Targeted Math practice

blocks.activity: Review one weak Math skill and its core methods.
Solve targeted questions, including a timed set.
Check answers and redo missed questions without notes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A corrected set of Math questions and a short error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Every missed question is corrected and its error cause is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Targeted Reading and Writing practice

blocks.activity: Review one weak Reading and Writing skill and its rules.
Complete targeted questions, including a timed set.
Check answers and explain the evidence or rule for each.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A corrected question set and a short error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Every missed question is corrected and its error cause is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Mixed timed practice

blocks.activity: Complete a timed mixed set across both SAT subjects.
Review every missed or uncertain answer.
Choose the next skills to target from the error patterns.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A timed-set result and prioritized follow-up skills.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The set is scored and all missed or uncertain answers are reviewed.

sessionTypes.title: Full-length SAT practice test

blocks.activity: Complete a full-length SAT practice test under official timing and conditions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed practice test with section scores.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All test sections are completed within their time limits.

sessionTypes.title: Practice test review

blocks.activity: Record section scores and compare them with the previous test.
Review missed and uncertain questions; solve them again.
Update the error log and select the next practice priorities.

sessionTypes.deliverable: An updated score tracker and ranked error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Every missed or uncertain question has a correction and next-step skill.

sessionTypes.title: Light skills refresh

blocks.activity: Recall key Math methods and Reading and Writing rules from memory.
Complete a small set of representative questions.
Check answers and note one item to revisit.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief recall sheet and checked question set.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The questions are checked and any uncertain rule or method is noted.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Establish easy running and introduce controlled speed.

sessionTypes.title: Easy run

blocks.activity: Walk briskly and jog gently.
Run at a relaxed, conversational effort.
Jog gently, then walk to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy run with effort noted.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish feeling able to continue.

sessionTypes.title: Steady run

blocks.activity: Jog gently to warm up.
Run at a steady, controlled effort.
Jog gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A steady run with effort noted.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the steady block without straining.

sessionTypes.title: 5K pace intervals

blocks.activity: Jog gently to warm up.
Alternate 1 minute brisk at 5K effort with 2 minutes easy.
Run relaxed strides with easy recovery.
Jog gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed interval session with repetitions recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish all brisk intervals with controlled form.

sessionTypes.title: Tempo intervals

blocks.activity: Jog gently to warm up.
Alternate 3 minutes comfortably hard with 2 minutes easy.
Jog gently to cool down.
Walk and note how the effort felt.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed tempo session with effort recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete each brisk segment at a controlled effort.

sessionTypes.title: Short recovery run

blocks.activity: Walk briskly and jog gently.
Run very easily.
Jog gently, then walk.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short, relaxed run with effort noted.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish at an easy, conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: 5K time trial

blocks.activity: Jog gently and prepare to run.
Run 5K at a strong, evenly paced effort.
Walk and jog gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A 5K time and pacing notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the distance and record your finish time.

phases.title: Set up and learn
phases.focus: Learn basic chord shapes and relaxed fretting.

phases.title: Build clean changes
phases.focus: Practice common chord pairs slowly, then steadily.

phases.title: Play with flow
phases.focus: Connect chords in a simple song pattern.

phases.title: Review
phases.focus: Ease off and show clean, confident chord changes.

sessionTypes.title: Open chord shapes

blocks.activity: Tune the guitar and settle into a relaxed posture.
Learn and place Em and G; check each string sounds clear.
Learn and place C and D; lift and reset fingers carefully.
Play each shape slowly and note any muted strings.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording of Em, G, C, and D played one at a time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Each chord rings clearly on at least three slow attempts.

sessionTypes.title: Chord-pair changes

blocks.activity: Warm up by placing each learned chord once.
Alternate Em and G slowly, keeping fingers close to the strings.
Alternate C and D slowly; pause to correct unclear notes.
Record one minute of each pair at a comfortable pace.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Two short recordings, one for each chord pair.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete ten deliberate changes per pair with most strings ringing clearly.

sessionTypes.title: Steady chord changes

blocks.activity: Tune and review Em, G, C, and D.
Practice Em–G–C–D slowly, one chord per four beats.
Repeat the progression with a steady down-strum and brief pauses as needed.
Record one uninterrupted progression.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of the four-chord progression.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Play the progression through three times without losing the order.

sessionTypes.title: Simple song flow

blocks.activity: Tune and check each chord shape.
Practice the Em–G–C–D progression with a slow count.
Strum one downstroke per beat, changing chords on the count.
Record a short, steady performance and listen for rough changes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short performance recording using all four chords.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Play the progression for one minute at a steady pace with clear chord changes.

sessionTypes.title: Chord-change review

blocks.activity: Tune and gently review each chord shape.
Play Em–G and C–D changes slowly, correcting unclear notes.
Record the full Em–G–C–D progression at a comfortable pace.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A final recording of the chord progression.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete three calm passes with the chord order intact and most notes clear.

phases.title: Fundamentos
phases.focus: Conocer conceptos básicos y practicar instrucciones, variables y tipos de datos.

phases.title: Control y funciones
phases.focus: Resolver ejercicios con condiciones, ciclos y funciones.

phases.title: Proyecto y repaso
phases.focus: Crear un programa pequeño, probarlo y consolidar lo aprendido.

sessionTypes.title: Lección guiada

blocks.activity: Repasar el objetivo de la lección.
Seguir una lección de un curso en línea y escribir ejemplos.
Recrear los ejemplos sin mirar la solución.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Apuntes breves y ejemplos ejecutables de la lección.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes explicar cada ejemplo y ejecutarlo sin errores.

sessionTypes.title: Práctica de ejercicios

blocks.activity: Elegir un concepto ya estudiado.
Resolver ejercicios pequeños sin copiar soluciones.
Probar casos distintos y corregir errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Ejercicios resueltos y guardados con sus pruebas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Los ejercicios funcionan con al menos dos casos de prueba.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso activo

blocks.activity: Anotar qué conceptos recordar.
Explicar conceptos con palabras propias y revisar apuntes.
Rehacer un ejercicio anterior sin consultar la solución.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Resumen de conceptos y un ejercicio rehecho.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes explicar el concepto y completar el ejercicio sin ayuda.

sessionTypes.title: Construcción de proyecto

blocks.activity: Definir una función pequeña para el proyecto.
Escribir y ejecutar código para completar esa función.
Probar el resultado y anotar el siguiente paso.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una función funcional integrada en el proyecto.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La función cumple su propósito y pasa pruebas sencillas.

sessionTypes.title: Pruebas y documentación

blocks.activity: Elegir una parte del programa para revisar.
Probar entradas variadas y corregir fallos simples.
Añadir comentarios claros e instrucciones de uso.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Pruebas anotadas y una guía breve de uso.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El programa supera las pruebas elegidas y otra persona puede seguir la guía.

sessions.title: Práctica de ejercicios

blocks.activity: Elegir un concepto ya estudiado.
Resolver ejercicios pequeños sin copiar soluciones.
Probar casos distintos y corregir errores.

sessions.deliverable: Ejercicios resueltos y guardados con sus pruebas.

sessions.title: Pruebas y documentación

blocks.activity: Elegir una parte del programa para revisar.

sessions.deliverable: Pruebas anotadas y una guía breve de uso.

sessions.title: Repaso activo

phases.title: Restart and assess
phases.focus: Rebuild a study routine and identify gaps in N4 vocabulary, grammar, kanji, reading, and listening.

phases.title: Build core skills
phases.focus: Study N4 grammar and vocabulary while practicing kanji, short reading, and listening.

phases.title: Practice and consolidate
phases.focus: Combine skills in timed practice, review errors, and strengthen weaker areas.

phases.title: Light review
phases.focus: Keep study light and focused on recall and confidence.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulary and kanji

blocks.activity: Review previously studied N4 words and kanji.
Learn a small set of new N4 vocabulary and kanji.
Test recall without looking at notes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A reviewed and newly learned word-and-kanji list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can recall the new items without prompts.

sessionTypes.title: N4 grammar practice

blocks.activity: Recall grammar points from the previous session.
Study two or three N4 grammar patterns with examples.
Write or choose original example sentences.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Example sentences using the grammar patterns studied.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain each pattern and use it correctly in an example.

sessionTypes.title: Reading practice

blocks.activity: Preview a short N4-level passage.
Read and mark unfamiliar words or grammar.
Answer comprehension questions and check evidence in the text.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed passage with answers and a short error list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have answered the questions and can point to supporting details.

sessionTypes.title: Listening practice

blocks.activity: Listen once for the main idea.
Listen again and note key words and details.
Check answers and replay difficult sections.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Listening answers and notes on missed details.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked every answer and identified why any missed detail was unclear.

sessionTypes.title: Mixed N4 review

blocks.activity: Review vocabulary and kanji with active recall.
Answer mixed grammar questions.
Review mistakes and add them to an error log.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed mixed review and updated error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked all answers and recorded each recurring mistake.

sessionTypes.title: Timed practice set

blocks.activity: Complete a timed N4-style question set.
Check answers and mark uncertain items.
Choose the top two areas to review next.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A scored practice set with two priority review areas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The set is completed within time and every answer is checked.

sessionTypes.title: Light recall review

blocks.activity: Review familiar vocabulary and kanji cards.
Recall key grammar patterns from memory.
Choose one item to revisit later.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recall check and one item for future review.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have completed the recall check without adding new material.

phases.title: Core React
phases.focus: Practice components, props, state, and event handling.

phases.title: Build and refine
phases.focus: Create a small app with forms, effects, and reusable components.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a React concept

blocks.activity: Write one question about the topic.
Study a focused lesson or documentation section.
Summarize the idea in your own words.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short concept note with one example.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The note explains the concept and includes a working example.

sessionTypes.title: Guided coding practice

blocks.activity: Choose one small React task.
Implement it in a focused coding session.
Run it and record one lesson learned.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A small working React feature.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The feature runs and its main behavior works.

sessionTypes.title: Project build session

blocks.activity: Pick one clearly scoped project improvement.
Build the improvement in small steps.
Check the result and note the next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A committed project improvement.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The change runs and is saved with a clear commit or note.

sessionTypes.title: Review and refactor

blocks.activity: Choose one component or recent change to review.
Improve naming, structure, or duplication.
Record what changed and why.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One clearer component and a brief rationale.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The app still runs and the improvement is documented.

sessionTypes.title: Test and explain

blocks.activity: Select one important user flow.
Test the flow and fix one issue or add a focused test.
Explain the component flow and state choices in writing.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A verified user flow and a concise technical explanation.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The flow works and the explanation accurately describes its data and state.

phases.title: Set up a steady practice
phases.focus: Choose a manageable dissertation target and establish a repeatable writing routine.

phases.title: Build draft momentum
phases.focus: Develop sections through focused drafting and regular revision.

phases.title: Connect and refine
phases.focus: Strengthen the argument, connect sections, and address the most important gaps.

phases.title: Review and carry forward
phases.focus: Review progress and set a clear next step.

sessionTypes.title: Plan the writing

blocks.activity: Review current dissertation notes and identify one priority.
Break the priority into a specific writing task.
Record when and where you will do the task.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short writing plan with one defined task.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The task and its next action are written down.

sessionTypes.title: Focused drafting

blocks.activity: Open the target section and reread its outline.
Draft new prose without stopping to polish.
Mark gaps and write the next starting point.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A new or expanded dissertation passage.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The passage is saved and the next step is noted.

sessionTypes.title: Revise a section

blocks.activity: Choose one section and one revision goal.
Revise for argument, structure, or clarity.
List unresolved questions and the next revision.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A revised section and a brief list of open questions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The revision is saved and remaining questions are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Connect the argument

blocks.activity: Review the claims and evidence in two related sections.
Draft or revise transitions that connect their ideas.
Note any missing evidence or explanation.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A clearer connection between sections, with gaps noted.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The transition is saved and any remaining gap is identified.

sessionTypes.title: Progress review

blocks.activity: Review the week's saved writing and notes.
Record what moved forward and what remains blocked.
Choose one concrete priority for the next week.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief progress note and next-week priority.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Progress, blockers, and the next priority are recorded.

phases.title: Observar y elegir
phases.focus: Identificar prioridades y probar una rutina breve de planificación.

phases.title: Crear constancia
phases.focus: Planificar la semana y proteger bloques de trabajo enfocado.

phases.title: Consolidar
phases.focus: Revisar resultados, ajustar la rutina y mantener lo que funciona.

sessionTypes.title: Revisión y planificación semanal

blocks.activity: Anota tareas pendientes y compromisos.
Elige hasta tres prioridades para la semana.
Reserva bloques de tiempo para las prioridades.
Define el primer paso de cada prioridad.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un plan semanal con prioridades y bloques reservados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Las prioridades tienen un bloque y un primer paso concretos.

sessionTypes.title: Bloque de trabajo enfocado

blocks.activity: Elige una tarea y prepara el espacio de trabajo.
Trabaja en la tarea sin cambiar de actividad.

phases.focus: Consolidar rodajes fáciles y aumentar gradualmente la tirada larga.

phases.focus: Ampliar el tiempo de carrera y practicar ritmos sostenidos sin agotarse.

phases.title: Construcción
phases.focus: Desarrollar resistencia específica con una sesión de calidad semanal.

phases.title: Descarga
phases.focus: Reducir el volumen progresivamente y llegar descansado al objetivo.

spec.title: Mejorar el inglés para el trabajo

phases.title: Base y diagnóstico
phases.focus: Identificar necesidades laborales y practicar vocabulario y expresiones frecuentes.

phases.title: Comunicación profesional
phases.focus: Mejorar la comprensión y la expresión en reuniones, correos y conversaciones de trabajo.

phases.title: Práctica integrada
phases.focus: Resolver situaciones laborales con mayor fluidez y autonomía.

phases.title: Repaso y cierre
phases.focus: Consolidar lo aprendido con una práctica breve y una revisión final.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulario laboral

blocks.activity: Repasar vocabulario de un tema laboral.
Crear frases propias con las palabras nuevas.
Practicar las frases en voz alta.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de 8 palabras con frases de ejemplo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes explicar y usar las 8 palabras en contexto.

sessionTypes.title: Comprensión auditiva profesional

blocks.activity: Leer el tema y anticipar vocabulario.
Escuchar un audio breve de trabajo y anotar ideas clave.
Resumir el audio en inglés.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Resumen breve con tres ideas clave.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El resumen recoge las ideas principales del audio.

sessionTypes.title: Escritura de correos

blocks.activity: Revisar el propósito y el tono del correo.
Redactar un correo laboral breve en inglés.
Revisar claridad, gramática y cortesía.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un correo profesional revisado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El correo comunica claramente su propósito y siguiente paso.

sessionTypes.title: Participación en reuniones

blocks.activity: Preparar el tema y tres expresiones útiles.
Practicar una intervención oral sobre un tema laboral.
Repetir la intervención con más claridad y concisión.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una intervención oral de uno o dos minutos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Presentas una idea y respondes a una pregunta en inglés.

sessionTypes.title: Simulación de situación laboral

blocks.activity: Elegir una situación laboral y preparar objetivos.
Representar una conversación laboral en inglés.
Anotar dudas y expresiones que faltaron.
Repetir la conversación incorporando mejoras.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de la simulación y expresiones mejoradas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas la conversación y aplicas al menos dos mejoras.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso y evaluación práctica

blocks.activity: Repasar vocabulario y expresiones de las semanas anteriores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Respuestas breves y una lista de próximos objetivos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Respondes con claridad y defines dos objetivos concretos.

spec.title: Crear y publicar un blog semanal

phases.title: Preparar el blog
phases.focus: Definir tema, público y formato; dejar listo el espacio de publicación.

phases.title: Crear el hábito
phases.focus: Redactar, revisar y publicar una entrada semanal.

phases.title: Consolidar y revisar
phases.focus: Mantener la publicación semanal y observar el progreso.

sessionTypes.title: Definir el blog

blocks.activity: Anota temas que te interesan y elige uno.
Describe a quién quieres escribir y qué le aportarás.
Elige un nombre provisional y un formato sencillo.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una ficha breve con tema, público, propuesta y nombre provisional.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La ficha contiene los cuatro elementos.

sessionTypes.title: Preparar el espacio

blocks.activity: Elige una plataforma y crea el espacio del blog.
Añade título, descripción y una presentación breve.
Prueba cómo guardar un borrador y publicar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un blog creado y listo para publicar.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes abrir el blog y guardar un borrador.

sessionTypes.title: Planificar una entrada

blocks.activity: Elige una idea concreta para la entrada.
Escribe un título provisional y tres puntos principales.
Define el siguiente paso y cuándo lo harás.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un esquema breve para una entrada.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El esquema tiene título, tres puntos y un siguiente paso.

sessionTypes.title: Redactar una entrada

blocks.activity: Revisa el esquema y fija el mensaje principal.
Escribe un primer borrador sin detenerte a pulirlo.
Completa las partes pendientes y guarda el borrador.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un borrador completo de la entrada semanal.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El borrador tiene título, inicio, desarrollo y cierre.

sessionTypes.title: Revisar y publicar

blocks.activity: Revisa claridad, orden y frases confusas.
Corrige errores y añade un título definitivo.
Publica la entrada y comprueba que se vea bien.
Registra el enlace y la fecha de publicación.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una entrada publicada con enlace registrado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La entrada está visible y el enlace queda guardado.

sessionTypes.title: Registrar el avance

blocks.activity: Anota qué publicaste o qué parte avanzaste.
Registra una dificultad y algo que funcionó.
Elige una idea para la próxima entrada.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una nota de progreso y una idea siguiente.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La nota incluye avance, observación e idea.

phases.title: Build the foundation
phases.focus: Review core vocabulary and grammar; establish a steady study routine.

phases.title: Develop HSK 4 skills
phases.focus: Expand vocabulary and practice reading, listening, and sentence use.

phases.title: Practice and consolidate
phases.focus: Work through mixed exam-style tasks, review weak areas, and finish with a lighter recap.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulary review

blocks.activity: Review previously studied HSK vocabulary with flashcards.
Learn a small set of new words and note example phrases.
Test recall without looking at the answers.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A reviewed word list with example phrases and recall results.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have tested every word and marked any missed items for review.

sessionTypes.title: Grammar and sentence practice

blocks.activity: Review one HSK 4 grammar pattern and its examples.
Complete focused exercises using the pattern.
Write original sentences and check them against the examples.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Completed exercises and a set of original sentences.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked each exercise and corrected unclear or incorrect sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Listening practice

blocks.activity: Preview the topic and any unfamiliar key words.
Listen to HSK 4-level audio and answer comprehension questions.
Replay difficult sections and note the words or details you missed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Answered listening questions and a short list of missed details.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked your answers and identified what to review.

sessionTypes.title: Reading practice

blocks.activity: Preview the passage title and questions.
Read an HSK 4-level passage and answer comprehension questions.
Check answers and note useful vocabulary or confusing sentences.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed reading exercise with review notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked every answer and recorded the main point of the passage.

sessionTypes.title: Mixed HSK practice

blocks.activity: Set up a timed set of HSK 4-style questions.
Complete mixed vocabulary, grammar, reading, or listening questions.
Check answers and classify mistakes by skill.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed question set with a brief error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have finished the set, checked it, and chosen one error pattern to review.

sessionTypes.title: Weekly recap

blocks.activity: Recall this week's vocabulary and grammar without notes.
Review missed questions or difficult audio and passages.
Choose the next week's study focus and materials.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recap of retained material and next steps.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have recorded what to revisit and selected a clear next focus.

spec.title: Return to Software and Build Full-Stack Skills

phases.title: Refresh and orient
phases.focus: Refresh programming fundamentals and choose a small project to build.

phases.title: Build the backend
phases.focus: Create a working API, connect a database, and practice testing.

phases.title: Complete the full stack
phases.focus: Connect a frontend to the API, polish the project, and prepare to present it.

phases.title: Review and showcase
phases.focus: Consolidate learning and present a finished project.

sessionTypes.title: Programming fundamentals refresh

blocks.activity: Review one core concept and write a short summary.
Solve small coding exercises using the concept.
Review solutions and note one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short concept note and completed exercises.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The exercises run and you can explain the main idea.

sessionTypes.title: Project planning and setup

blocks.activity: Choose a small, useful project and define its core user.
List essential features and sketch the data and screens.
Create a repository and write setup instructions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A project outline and initialized repository.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The scope is small, the repository exists, and setup steps are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Build an API

blocks.activity: Review the API task and identify its inputs and outputs.
Implement one or two project endpoints.
Exercise the endpoints and record results.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Working API endpoints with example requests and responses.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The endpoints return the expected results for normal and invalid inputs.

sessionTypes.title: Data modeling and persistence

blocks.activity: Identify the project data and its relationships.
Create a schema and connect persistence to the API.
Test creating, reading, and updating a record.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A documented data model and persistent API operations.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Data survives a restart and the main operations pass a manual check.

sessionTypes.title: Testing and debugging

blocks.activity: Choose one important behavior and define expected results.
Write or run focused tests and fix one defect.
Record what the tests cover and any remaining issue.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A small set of tests and a concise issue note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Tests pass and the chosen behavior is checked.

sessionTypes.title: Build the frontend

blocks.activity: Sketch the screen and identify its key user action.
Build a screen with clear loading, success, and error states.
Check the screen at a narrow and wide viewport.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A usable project screen with responsive layout.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The main action works and the screen remains usable at both widths.

sessionTypes.title: Connect frontend and backend

blocks.activity: Trace the data flow from user action to stored result.
Connect the screen to the API and handle responses.
Run one complete user flow and note any defects.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A working end-to-end project flow.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: A user action updates or retrieves data through the API.

sessionTypes.title: Polish and present the project

blocks.activity: Choose one high-value improvement or cleanup task.
Complete the improvement and remove one rough edge.
Update the README and rehearse a brief project walkthrough.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A polished project, updated README, and short walkthrough.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The project starts from documented steps and its purpose and design are easy to explain.

phases.title: Reencuentro con el teclado
phases.focus: Recuperar comodidad, postura y coordinación con sesiones breves.

phases.title: Reconstruir fundamentos
phases.focus: Practicar escalas, independencia de manos y lectura a ritmo controlado.

phases.title: Integrar técnica y repertorio
phases.focus: Aplicar los fundamentos a pasajes musicales y mejorar continuidad.

phases.title: Consolidar y revisar
phases.focus: Unir lo aprendido en una pieza y cerrar con una semana más ligera.

sessionTypes.title: Técnica suave

blocks.activity: Ajusta el banco, la postura y la altura de las manos.
Toca patrones de cinco notas lentamente con cada mano.
Practica escalas cómodas, manos separadas y luego juntas.
Repite los patrones con sonido uniforme y relajado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una escala y un patrón de cinco notas practicados con ambas manos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas los bloques sin acelerar y manteniendo movimientos cómodos.

sessionTypes.title: Lectura y coordinación

blocks.activity: Prepara una partitura sencilla y marca el pulso.
Lee y toca una línea breve con cada mano por separado.
Combina las manos en fragmentos cortos, a tempo lento.
Repite el fragmento y anota los compases difíciles.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un fragmento breve leído y tocado con ambas manos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes tocar el fragmento completo lentamente y señalar dónde necesitas más práctica.

sessionTypes.title: Pasajes con control

blocks.activity: Elige dos pasajes breves de una pieza adecuada.
Practica cada pasaje por separado, con manos separadas.
Une las manos y repite despacio, cuidando ritmo y articulación.
Toca los pasajes seguidos y registra el tempo cómodo.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Dos pasajes practicados y un tempo de referencia anotado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Tocas ambos pasajes seguidos sin detenerte más de una vez.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso ligero

blocks.activity: Prepara el teclado y elige un ejercicio conocido.
Repasa escalas o patrones cómodos a ritmo lento.
Toca una sección sencilla del repertorio.
Anota qué salió bien y qué retomarás.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un ejercicio y una sección de repertorio repasados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Terminas sin forzar el tempo y dejas una nota concreta para la próxima sesión.

sessionTypes.title: Integración de una pieza

blocks.activity: Define un objetivo concreto para la pieza.
Repasa por separado los pasajes que presentan dificultad.
Toca secciones enlazadas con ambas manos a tempo cómodo.
Interpreta la pieza completa o la mayor parte sin detenerte.
Anota el tempo y el siguiente ajuste técnico.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una interpretación grabada o una nota de progreso sobre la pieza.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Tocas la pieza completa o identificas con precisión el pasaje que falta integrar.

sessions.title: Técnica suave

blocks.activity: Ajusta el banco, la postura y la altura de las manos.
Toca patrones de cinco notas lentamente con cada mano.
Practica escalas cómodas, manos separadas y luego juntas.

spec.title: Preparación para un trail de montaña

phases.title: Base y técnica
phases.focus: Consolidar carrera fácil y técnica de subida y bajada; salida de montaña el fin de semana.

phases.title: Desnivel y resistencia
phases.focus: Aumentar gradualmente el tiempo en montaña y practicar subidas sostenidas y descensos controlados.

phases.title: Especificidad
phases.focus: Acercarse a las exigencias del trail con salidas largas, desnivel y ritmo constante.

phases.title: Descarga
phases.focus: Reducir la carga y llegar con frescura, manteniendo algo de movimiento fácil.

sessionTypes.title: Carrera fácil

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar suave para entrar en calor.
Correr a ritmo cómodo, pudiendo hablar.
Trotar muy suave y caminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de minutos y sensación de esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa 40 minutos sin perder el ritmo conversacional.

sessionTypes.title: Cuestas controladas

blocks.activity: Trote fácil de calentamiento.
Repetir subidas a esfuerzo moderado y bajar con pasos cortos y controlados.
Trote suave o caminata para soltar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Número de subidas y nota sobre el control en las bajadas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Termina las repeticiones manteniendo esfuerzo moderado y bajadas controladas.

sessionTypes.title: Salida de montaña

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar suave por terreno sencillo.
Alternar trote y caminata en senderos, practicando subidas y bajadas con control.
Caminar suave para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tiempo, desnivel aproximado y observaciones del terreno.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa 75 minutos en montaña a esfuerzo fácil y con control.

sessionTypes.title: Tirada larga de montaña

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar suave para calentar.
Avanzar por senderos a esfuerzo fácil, alternando carrera y caminata en las subidas.
Caminar suave para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tiempo, desnivel aproximado y nota de esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa 100 minutos a esfuerzo fácil, sin acelerar al final.

sessionTypes.title: Tirada larga específica

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar suave para calentar.
Recorrer senderos con desnivel a esfuerzo fácil; caminar las subidas pronunciadas y bajar con control.
Caminar suave para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tiempo, desnivel aproximado y nota sobre el ritmo en terreno técnico.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa 120 minutos manteniendo un esfuerzo fácil y estable.

sessionTypes.title: Trote de recuperación

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar muy suave.
Trotar en terreno llano a ritmo cómodo.
Caminar para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de minutos y sensación al terminar.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa 30 minutos con esfuerzo muy fácil.

sessions.title: Cuestas controladas

blocks.activity: Trote fácil de calentamiento.

sessions.deliverable: Número de subidas y nota sobre el control en las bajadas.

phases.title: Ease into training
phases.focus: Build a comfortable aerobic base and basic strength.

phases.title: Build hockey fitness
phases.focus: Gradually add steady running and controlled changes of pace.

phases.title: Prepare and ease off
phases.focus: Practise short hockey-style efforts, then reduce training before club sessions.

sessionTypes.title: Easy run-walk

blocks.activity: Brisk walk to warm up.
Alternate easy jogging and walking; keep the effort conversational.
Walk to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed run-walk and a note of the jogging intervals.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish all intervals at a conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: Brisk walk

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Walk briskly at a steady, comfortable pace.
Walk gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed brisk walk.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the walk while able to speak in full sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Basic strength

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy marching and joint movements.
Complete controlled rounds of chair squats, glute bridges, calf raises, and incline push-ups, resting as needed.
Walk easily and loosen up.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A record of completed strength rounds.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the planned movements with controlled form and no rushing.

sessionTypes.title: Steady run-walk

blocks.activity: Brisk walk to warm up.
Alternate easy jogging and walking, with slightly longer jogging intervals than before.
Walk to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed steady run-walk and interval notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the intervals at a controlled effort, without sprinting.

sessionTypes.title: Hockey-style intervals

blocks.activity: Walk and jog easily to warm up.
Repeat 30 seconds of quicker running followed by 90 seconds of easy walking or jogging.
Practise gentle side steps and short controlled direction changes.
Walk to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed interval set and a note of repetitions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete each quicker effort under control and recover easily between efforts.

sessionTypes.title: Long easy run-walk

blocks.activity: Brisk walk to warm up.
Alternate easy jogging and walking at a conversational effort.
Walk to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed longer run-walk and a note of total time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the full session at an easy, sustainable effort.

phases.title: Diagnose and build foundations
phases.focus: Establish a baseline, learn the exam format, and identify priority skills.

phases.title: Strengthen core skills
phases.focus: Practice quantitative, verbal, and data insights skills with focused review.

phases.title: Integrate and improve timing
phases.focus: Build stamina with timed practice, analyze errors, and refine test strategy.

phases.title: Taper and consolidate
phases.focus: Complete a final readiness check, review key lessons, and reduce workload.

sessionTypes.title: Baseline GMAT practice

blocks.activity: Review test format and set up a quiet practice environment.
Complete a timed mixed-section diagnostic.
Record results and note the three biggest skill gaps.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A diagnostic score summary and three priority gaps.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All timed questions are attempted and the gaps are written down.

sessionTypes.title: Quantitative foundations

blocks.activity: Review one core quantitative concept.
Solve targeted practice questions without rushing.
Check solutions and log errors with their causes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed question set and an updated quantitative error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Every missed question has a corrected solution and a brief cause.

sessionTypes.title: Verbal foundations

blocks.activity: Review a reading or critical reasoning approach.
Complete focused verbal practice questions.
Review answers and record recurring reasoning errors.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed verbal question set and an updated error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Each missed answer has a clear explanation of the correct reasoning.

sessionTypes.title: Data insights practice

blocks.activity: Review the question formats and the information each requires.
Solve a focused set of data insights questions.
Review solutions and note any interpretation mistakes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed data insights set with notes on missed questions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All answers are checked and missed questions are explained.

sessionTypes.title: Timed mixed practice

blocks.activity: Set a section goal and prepare a timing plan.
Complete a timed mixed set across exam skills.
Review errors and identify one timing adjustment.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A timed practice result and one specific timing adjustment.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The set is completed to time and every error is reviewed.

sessionTypes.title: Full-length practice exam

blocks.activity: Set up the exam conditions and review the section order.
Complete a timed full-length practice exam.
Record section results and flag questions for later review.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A full practice exam result with flagged review questions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All sections are completed to time and results are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Error log and strategy review

blocks.activity: Choose recent missed or uncertain questions.
Redo questions and explain the correct approach.
Write concise takeaways and select the next practice target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A refreshed error log and one next-step practice target.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Selected questions are solved again and takeaways are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Final readiness review

blocks.activity: Review the personal test-day strategy.
Revisit a small set of representative questions.
Summarize strengths, reminders, and remaining uncertainties.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A one-page test-day strategy and concise review notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The strategy and final reminders are written and easy to scan.

phases.title: Build pulling foundations
phases.focus: Practice controlled pulling, grip, and shoulder-blade movement.

phases.title: Develop strength
phases.focus: Progress assisted pull-ups and build controlled lowering strength.

phases.title: Test and recover
phases.focus: Practice lighter assistance, attempt a strict pull-up when ready, then ease off.

sessionTypes.title: Pull-up foundations

blocks.activity: Warm up shoulders and wrists with easy arm circles and band pull-aparts.
Assisted-machine pull-ups: 3 sets of 8, using smooth, controlled reps.
Scapular pull-ups: 3 sets of 6, pausing briefly at the bottom.
Dead hangs: 4 comfortable holds, resting between efforts.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Record assistance, reps, and hang times.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all planned sets with controlled movement and no swinging.

sessionTypes.title: Pull-up strength

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy band pull-aparts and shoulder circles.
Assisted-machine pull-ups: 4 sets of 6, reducing assistance only if reps stay smooth.
Slow assisted lowers: 3 sets of 3, taking about 3 seconds to lower.
Dead hangs: 4 comfortable holds with full rests.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Log assistance, completed reps, and hang times.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the sets with controlled reps and no forced repetitions.

sessionTypes.title: Pull-up technique practice

blocks.activity: Warm up shoulders and wrists with easy mobility.
Lightly assisted pull-ups: 3 sets of 6 at an easy effort.
Scapular pull-ups: 3 sets of 5, moving slowly and smoothly.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Note assistance and technique cues that felt useful.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete every rep smoothly, stopping well before fatigue.

sessionTypes.title: Pull-up readiness check

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy shoulder and wrist mobility.
Complete 2 easy assisted pull-up sets of 5.
Rest fully, then make one unassisted pull-up attempt only if the setup feels controlled.
Finish with 2 light assisted sets of 4 and record the result.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Record whether an unassisted rep was completed and the assistance used.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the easy work and make no more than one unassisted attempt.

sessionTypes.title: Easy pull-up practice

blocks.activity: Warm up shoulders and wrists with gentle mobility.
Assisted pull-ups: 2 easy sets of 5 with comfortable assistance.
Complete 2 relaxed dead hangs with full rest.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Log the assistance and how the reps felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish feeling fresh, with no grinding or strained reps.

phases.title: Formas y observación
phases.focus: Practicar formas simples, proporciones y rasgos expresivos.

phases.title: Construcción de personajes
phases.focus: Combinar siluetas, expresiones y poses en caricaturas legibles.

sessionTypes.title: Formas y siluetas

blocks.activity: Reúne referencias de objetos o animales.
Dibuja siluetas con formas geométricas simples.
Elige las tres siluetas más claras y anota por qué.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una hoja con seis siluetas y tres selecciones.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Las seis siluetas se distinguen sin detalles internos.

sessionTypes.title: Rasgos y expresiones

blocks.activity: Elige un personaje sencillo como referencia.
Prueba variaciones de ojos, nariz y boca.
Dibuja cuatro expresiones con rasgos exagerados.
Marca la expresión más legible.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una hoja de cuatro expresiones del mismo personaje.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Cada expresión se entiende sin etiquetas.

sessionTypes.title: Construcción de personaje

blocks.activity: Define una idea de personaje en una frase.
Prueba tres proporciones distintas de cabeza y cuerpo.
Dibuja el personaje en dos poses sencillas.
Selecciona la versión más reconocible.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una ficha con concepto, tres proporciones y dos poses.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El personaje conserva rasgos reconocibles en ambas poses.

sessionTypes.title: Línea y acabado

blocks.activity: Prepara un boceto pequeño.
Repasa contornos con líneas de distinto grosor.
Simplifica detalles que dificulten la lectura.
Compara el resultado con el boceto.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una caricatura con contornos limpios y jerarquía de línea.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La silueta y la expresión se leen a tamaño pequeño.

sessionTypes.title: Composición para estampado

blocks.activity: Elige un personaje y una idea breve para el estampado.
Haz tres miniaturas con composiciones distintas.
Desarrolla la composición más clara en un boceto.
Comprueba que el diseño funciona en pequeño.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tres miniaturas y un boceto de estampado seleccionado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El personaje y la idea se reconocen en una miniatura.

sessionTypes.title: Ilustración final

blocks.activity: Revisa el boceto elegido y fija sus elementos principales.
Redibuja la composición con proporciones y pose claras.
Limpia contornos y aplica una paleta limitada.
Revisa legibilidad y corrige detalles confusos.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una ilustración de caricatura terminada para estampado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La pieza está limpia y se entiende al verla en tamaño reducido.

sessionTypes.title: Revisión y presentación

blocks.activity: Compara bocetos y piezas terminadas.
Anota dos avances y un aspecto por practicar.
Prepara una página con la pieza elegida y su concepto.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una página de presentación con una nota de progreso.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La página muestra la pieza y explica su idea en una frase.

spec.title: Return to Trail Running and Climbing

phases.title: Ease back in
phases.focus: Rebuild a gentle routine with easy trail time and relaxed climbing.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Gradually extend easy running and climbing practice while keeping recovery manageable.

phases.title: Strengthen the routine
phases.focus: Consolidate steady trail outings and relaxed climbing; finish with a lighter week.

phases.title: Open week
phases.focus: No scheduled sessions; resume gently when time and energy allow.

sessionTypes.title: Easy trail run-walk

blocks.activity: Walk easily and check the trail underfoot.
Alternate relaxed jogging and walking on gentle terrain.
Walk easily to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short note of route and total time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish feeling able to continue at an easy pace.

sessionTypes.title: Relaxed climbing session

blocks.activity: Move gently on easy climbs and warm up.
Climb comfortable routes with generous rests.
Finish with easy movement and note routes tried.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A list of routes tried and one movement cue.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete relaxed attempts without pushing for a grade.

sessionTypes.title: Steady trail run-walk

blocks.activity: Walk easily to settle into the outing.
Use relaxed jog-walk intervals on forgiving trails.
Walk easily to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A route and time log with a brief effort rating.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Keep the effort conversational throughout.

sessionTypes.title: Easy climbing skills

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy movement.
Practice quiet feet and balanced movement on easy climbs.
Rest between relaxed attempts and record one useful cue.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One movement cue to remember next time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the planned easy attempts without straining.

question: ¿Qué tipo de cosas te gustaría construir o aprender a hacer?

phases.title: Herramientas y seguridad
phases.focus: Conocer herramientas, materiales y medidas; practicar cortes y uniones sencillas.

phases.title: Diseño y prototipos
phases.focus: Planificar un mueble pequeño y probar sus piezas y uniones.

phases.title: Construcción
phases.focus: Construir y ajustar un mueble pequeño con un proceso ordenado.

phases.title: Acabado y revisión
phases.focus: Terminar el proyecto, revisar su estabilidad y documentar lo aprendido.

sessionTypes.title: Herramientas y seguridad

blocks.activity: Preparar el espacio y repasar prácticas seguras.
Identificar herramientas y practicar su manejo sin prisa.
Limpiar y guardar herramientas.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de herramientas y notas de seguridad.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes nombrar las herramientas usadas y explicar cómo guardarlas con seguridad.

sessionTypes.title: Medición y cortes de práctica

blocks.activity: Marcar medidas en retales.
Practicar cortes y comprobarlos con una escuadra.
Anotar errores y ordenar el espacio.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Retales cortados y registro de medidas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Los cortes están marcados y comparados con las medidas previstas.

sessionTypes.title: Práctica de uniones

blocks.activity: Elegir una unión sencilla y preparar retales.
Practicar el ajuste y ensamblar una unión de prueba.
Revisar el ajuste y registrar cambios.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una unión de prueba y notas de ajuste.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La unión queda ensamblada y puedes describir qué mejorarías.

sessionTypes.title: Diseño del mueble

blocks.activity: Elegir un mueble pequeño y definir su uso.
Dibujar vistas y anotar medidas de las piezas.
Revisar que las piezas y uniones sean coherentes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Boceto acotado y lista de piezas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El boceto muestra medidas y una lista de piezas que se puede revisar.

sessionTypes.title: Prototipo y ajustes

blocks.activity: Preparar cartón o retales para probar el diseño.
Montar un prototipo sencillo y comprobar proporciones.
Anotar ajustes para el diseño final.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Prototipo sencillo con lista de ajustes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El prototipo permite comprobar las proporciones y tiene ajustes anotados.

sessionTypes.title: Construcción del mueble

blocks.activity: Revisar el plano y preparar materiales.
Medir, cortar y ensamblar las piezas principales.
Comprobar escuadra, ajuste y estabilidad; anotar pendientes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Mueble ensamblado o avance principal documentado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Las piezas principales están unidas y los ajustes pendientes están registrados.

sessionTypes.title: Acabado y revisión

blocks.activity: Inspeccionar superficies y uniones.
Lijar y completar el acabado elegido según sus instrucciones.
Revisar estabilidad y documentar el resultado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Mueble terminado y registro del proceso.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El mueble está revisado, estable y con el acabado previsto completado.

question: What would you like to learn?

phases.title: Set up and learn the basics
phases.focus: Choose a beginner project, learn safe tool handling, and practice measuring, marking, and basic cuts.

phases.title: Build core skills
phases.focus: Practice accurate cuts and simple joints, then use them in a small project.

phases.title: Finish and reflect
phases.focus: Complete a project, improve the finish, and record skills and next steps.

sessionTypes.title: Choose and plan a project

blocks.activity: Browse beginner project ideas and choose one suited to available tools.
Sketch the project with approximate dimensions.
List materials, tools, and questions to resolve.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A project sketch and a short materials and tools list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The project is chosen and its basic requirements are written down.

sessionTypes.title: Learn workshop safety

blocks.activity: Review the safety instructions for the tools and workspace you will use.
Identify safe workholding, clear workspace, and protective equipment for each tool.
Practice a pre-work safety check without cutting.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written safety checklist for the workspace and chosen tools.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain the checklist and complete it before starting work.

sessionTypes.title: Practice measuring and marking

blocks.activity: Practice reading a ruler or tape measure and marking measured lengths on scrap.
Use a square to mark straight lines across scrap.
Compare marks with measurements and note any errors.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked scrap piece with measured lines and a brief accuracy note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have made and checked at least five measured marks.

sessionTypes.title: Practice straight cuts

blocks.activity: Set up scrap securely and review the tool instructions.
Make several straight cuts on scrap using an appropriate beginner tool.
Check cut edges and compare each cut with its marked line.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Several practice cuts with notes on accuracy and control.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have made at least three cuts and checked them against the marks.

sessionTypes.title: Practice a simple joint

blocks.activity: Choose a simple beginner joint and review its steps.
Mark and shape two scrap pieces for the joint.
Test the fit and record what needs adjustment.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A trial joint made from scrap and a note about its fit.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The pieces fit together for inspection and you have recorded one improvement.

sessionTypes.title: Build the project

blocks.activity: Review the sketch, measurements, and safety checklist.
Measure, mark, and cut project pieces, checking dimensions as you go.
Dry-fit or assemble the pieces and note any adjustments needed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Project pieces cut and dry-fitted or assembled, with an adjustment list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The main pieces are prepared and their fit has been checked.

sessionTypes.title: Finish and review

blocks.activity: Inspect the project and identify rough areas or visible gaps.
Sand or refine the surface using an appropriate method for the project.
Photograph the result and write down skills learned and next steps.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A finished project photo and a short skills review.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The project has been inspected, refined, and documented.

sessionTypes.title: Set up reading log

sessionTypes.title: Review reading week

sessionTypes.doneWhen: The entries are checked and page totals are written down.

phases.title: Base y evaluación
phases.focus: Retomar desplazamientos, guardia y fundamentos con control.

phases.title: Técnica y combinaciones
phases.focus: Practicar golpes, defensas y combinaciones sencillas.

phases.title: Aplicación progresiva
phases.focus: Integrar técnica con ejercicios de reacción y contacto controlado.

phases.title: Consolidación
phases.focus: Repasar fundamentos con una sesión ligera.

sessionTypes.title: Guardia y desplazamientos

blocks.activity: Movilidad general y pasos suaves.
Practica guardia, avance, retroceso y pasos laterales.
Repite desplazamientos manteniendo equilibrio y distancia.
Repaso lento y vuelta a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una secuencia breve de desplazamientos desde la guardia.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completes la secuencia sin cruzar los pies ni perder el equilibrio.

sessionTypes.title: Golpes y defensas básicas

blocks.activity: Calentamiento con movilidad y pasos.
Practica golpes rectos al aire o a un saco, con control.
Ensaya coberturas y salidas sencillas ante ataques simulados.
Alterna una defensa y una respuesta, despacio y con precisión.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una combinación de defensa y respuesta que puedas demostrar.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Realizas la combinación con guardia estable y movimientos controlados.

sessionTypes.title: Combinaciones y distancia

blocks.activity: Calentamiento suave y desplazamientos.
Practica combinaciones cortas de golpes con buena postura.
Entra y sal de distancia con pasos controlados.
Combina una defensa, una respuesta y una salida.
Repaso técnico lento.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Dos combinaciones con entrada, respuesta y salida.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Demuestras ambas sin perder la guardia ni precipitarte.

sessionTypes.title: Reacción con compañero

blocks.activity: Calentamiento y acuerdos claros de contacto.
Practica respuestas a señales visuales sin contacto.

phases.title: Build the habit
phases.focus: Start gently with repeatable full-body strength and easy movement.

phases.title: Build capacity
phases.focus: Gradually add strength work and steady aerobic time.

phases.title: Consolidate
phases.focus: Keep sessions consistent, then ease off in the final week.

sessionTypes.title: Easy brisk walk

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Walk at a comfortable, steady pace.
Slow down and finish relaxed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed walk and a note of how it felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish feeling able to continue a little longer.

sessionTypes.title: Full-body strength A

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy marching and joint circles.
Cycle through chair squats, incline push-ups, hip hinges, and dead bugs at a controlled pace.
Move gently and note any exercise to adjust next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed strength circuit with exercise variations recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete controlled rounds without rushing or straining.

sessionTypes.title: Full-body strength B

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy marching and shoulder and hip circles.
Cycle through step-backs, glute bridges, backpack rows, and bird dogs at a controlled pace.
Move gently and record the variations used.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed strength circuit with exercise variations recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish each movement with steady form and no rushed repetitions.

sessionTypes.title: Steady aerobic walk

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Walk briskly at a pace where conversation remains comfortable.
Slow down and finish relaxed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed steady walk and its duration.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the brisk section while still able to speak in sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Long easy walk

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Walk at an easy, sustainable pace.
Slow down and finish relaxed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy walk and a note on energy afterward.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish at a comfortable pace without pushing for speed.

sessionTypes.title: Gentle mobility reset

blocks.activity: Move gently through shoulder rolls and easy marching.
Practice comfortable hip hinges and ankle rocks.
Finish with relaxed, pain-free range-of-motion movements.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short list of movements that felt comfortable.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the movements gently without forcing range.

spec.title: Run Faster and Continuously with the Pram

phases.title: Build the routine
phases.focus: Establish easy pram-running sessions and gradually extend continuous running.

phases.title: Extend endurance
phases.focus: Build steady running time and introduce short, controlled pace changes.

phases.title: Run continuously
phases.focus: Practice longer continuous pram runs and measured faster efforts.

phases.title: Ease off
phases.focus: Reduce training time and finish with a comfortable continuous run.

sessionTypes.title: Easy run-walk

blocks.activity: Walk briskly with the pram.
Alternate 1 minute easy jogging and 1 minute walking.
Walk easily with the pram.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A relaxed pram run-walk session.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all blocks at a comfortable effort.

sessionTypes.title: Steady run-walk

blocks.activity: Walk briskly with the pram.
Alternate 3 minutes easy jogging and 2 minutes walking.
Walk easily with the pram.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A longer, controlled pram run-walk.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish all intervals without needing to increase effort.

sessionTypes.title: Continuous running practice

blocks.activity: Walk briskly with the pram.
Jog continuously at an easy, conversational pace; walk briefly if needed.
Walk easily with the pram.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A sustained pram run with a continuous-running attempt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the running block at a controlled effort.

sessionTypes.title: Gentle pace changes

blocks.activity: Walk briskly with the pram.
Repeat 1 minute brisk running and 3 minutes easy jogging.
Walk easily with the pram.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Four controlled brisk efforts during a pram run.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish each brisk effort smoothly and recover at an easy pace.

sessionTypes.title: Long continuous pram run

blocks.activity: Walk briskly with the pram.
Run continuously at an easy, conversational pace; walk briefly if needed.
Walk easily with the pram.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A longer pram run with a continuous-running attempt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the main block at an even, comfortable effort.

phases.title: Return to riding
phases.focus: Rebuild an easy riding routine and comfortable time in the saddle.

phases.title: Build endurance
phases.focus: Gradually extend easy rides and introduce controlled hill practice.

phases.title: Develop climbing strength
phases.focus: Build steady climbing efforts and longer endurance rides.

phases.title: Specific endurance
phases.focus: Practice sustained hilly riding and pacing on longer rides.

phases.title: Peak and taper
phases.focus: Reach a final endurance peak, then reduce riding time while keeping legs fresh.

sessionTypes.title: Easy endurance ride

blocks.activity: Ride gently to warm up.
Ride at a relaxed, conversational effort.
Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with duration and route.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete 30 minutes at a conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: Steady endurance ride

blocks.activity: Ride gently to warm up.
Ride steadily at a conversational effort.
Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with duration and route.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete 45 minutes at a steady, conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled hill practice

blocks.activity: Warm up gently on easy terrain.
Climb at a controlled, steady effort.
Recover easily.
Repeat a controlled climb.
Ride easily on rolling or flat terrain.
Cool down gently.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log noting climbs and perceived effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish both climbs without surging and recover easily between them.

sessionTypes.title: Long endurance ride

blocks.activity: Start gently on easy terrain.
Ride at a relaxed, conversational effort.
Finish with an easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with duration, route, and how the effort felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete 60 minutes at an easy, sustainable effort.

sessionTypes.title: Long hilly endurance ride

blocks.activity: Warm up gently on easy terrain.
Ride rolling terrain at a conversational effort; climb steadily.
Cool down gently.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with route, climbing, and duration.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete 75 minutes, keeping climbs controlled and the overall effort easy.

sessionTypes.title: Steady climbing intervals

blocks.activity: Warm up gently.
Climb at a steady, controlled effort.
Recover easily.
Repeat the steady climb.
Recover easily.
Repeat the steady climb.
Ride easily, then cool down.
Finish with a gentle spin.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log noting interval effort and recovery.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete three controlled climbs with easy recoveries and no all-out efforts.

sessionTypes.title: Hilly event simulation

blocks.activity: Warm up gently.
Ride rolling terrain at a sustainable conversational effort; climb steadily.
Cool down gently.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ride log with route, climbing, duration, and pacing notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete 90 minutes at a sustainable effort without hard surges.

phases.title: Build a steady base
phases.focus: Practice controlled kettlebell technique and establish a sustainable routine.

phases.title: Build strength and work capacity
phases.focus: Progress gradually with balanced strength and conditioning sessions.

phases.title: Consolidate
phases.focus: Maintain quality and consistency without adding unnecessary volume.

phases.title: Ease off
phases.focus: Complete one relaxed session and finish feeling fresh.

sessionTypes.title: Strength A

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up and unloaded hinge practice.
Kettlebell deadlift and goblet squat, controlled sets with full rests.
One-arm row and floor press, alternating sides with full rests.
Easy cooldown and note loads and repetitions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A training log with loads and repetitions for each exercise.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All planned sets are completed with controlled technique and no rushed repetitions.

sessionTypes.title: Strength B

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up and unloaded squat and press practice.
Kettlebell clean and press practice, alternating sides with full rests.
Reverse lunge and suitcase carry, alternating sides with full rests.
Easy cooldown and record the session.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A training log with loads, repetitions, and carry distance.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All planned sets are completed with stable positions and controlled effort.

sessionTypes.title: Easy Skill Practice

blocks.activity: Gentle mobility and unloaded movement rehearsal.
Light kettlebell hinge, squat, and carry practice with generous rests.
Easy cooldown and write one technique cue.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One written technique cue and a brief practice log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Practice stays easy, movements remain controlled, and the cue is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Kettlebell Conditioning

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up and light hinge practice.
Short, controlled kettlebell swing intervals with generous recovery between rounds.
Easy cooldown and record completed rounds.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A log of completed rounds and the kettlebell used.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The planned rounds are complete with crisp repetitions and no loss of control.

phases.title: Rebuild the HSK 2 foundation
phases.focus: Review core vocabulary and grammar; establish consistent listening, reading, and writing practice.

phases.title: Build HSK 3 range
phases.focus: Expand vocabulary and sentence patterns; practice understanding short texts and conversations.

phases.title: Bridge to HSK 4
phases.focus: Study HSK 4 vocabulary and grammar; increase reading length and listening complexity.

phases.title: Develop exam skills
phases.focus: Practice timed listening, reading, and writing tasks; review errors and weak areas.

phases.title: Full practice and refinement
phases.focus: Complete full-length practice tests and target recurring mistakes.

phases.title: Taper and consolidate
phases.focus: Reduce study load, revisit high-value material, and keep exam skills fresh.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulary review

blocks.activity: Recall previously studied words without looking.
Learn a small set of new HSK words with example sentences.
Test recall and record missed words.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A reviewed word list with example sentences and missed words marked.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can recall the reviewed words and identify the ones needing another pass.

sessionTypes.title: Grammar and sentence practice

blocks.activity: Review one grammar pattern and its examples.
Write original sentences using the pattern.
Complete short exercises and correct errors.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A set of corrected sentences using the target grammar.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain the pattern and use it accurately in your own sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Listening practice

blocks.activity: Preview key words and the listening task.
Listen to level-appropriate audio and answer questions.
Replay difficult sections and note missed details.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Answered listening questions and a short list of missed details.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have checked your answers and can explain the main points of the audio.

sessionTypes.title: Reading practice

blocks.activity: Preview the text and identify the task.
Read a level-appropriate passage and answer questions.
Check answers and review unfamiliar words in context.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed reading task with corrected answers and useful words noted.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can summarize the passage and account for each corrected answer.

sessionTypes.title: Writing practice

blocks.activity: Review the prompt and plan a clear response.
Write a short response using current vocabulary and grammar.
Check word order, grammar, and completeness; revise.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A revised response to a level-appropriate writing prompt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The response addresses the prompt and has been checked for common errors.

sessionTypes.title: Timed HSK practice test

blocks.activity: Complete a timed listening and reading practice set.
Complete a timed writing practice set.
Check answers and categorize mistakes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A timed practice score and an error log grouped by skill.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All sections are attempted, checked, and the main error patterns are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Error review and consolidation

blocks.activity: Review recent vocabulary and grammar errors.
Redo missed questions without notes.
Write a short plan for the next review.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Corrected missed questions and a prioritized review list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have retried each selected error and recorded what to revisit.

phases.title: Set up and diagnose
phases.focus: List subjects and mock topics, identify gaps, and establish a realistic revision routine.

phases.title: Build core knowledge
phases.focus: Review key topics and practise retrieval across subjects.

phases.title: Apply and improve
phases.focus: Use timed exam questions, mark them, and target recurring gaps.

phases.title: Final review
phases.focus: Consolidate priority topics with shorter, focused practice.

sessionTypes.title: Plan and diagnose

blocks.activity: List mock subjects and topics.
Try a short set of questions across priority subjects.
Mark answers and record gaps in a topic tracker.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A mock topic tracker with priority gaps.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Subjects and topics are listed, and at least three gaps are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Topic retrieval practice

blocks.activity: Recall a topic from memory without notes.
Check notes and correct missing or inaccurate points.
Answer practice questions on the topic.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A corrected recall sheet and completed questions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Recall is checked against notes and every question is attempted.

sessionTypes.title: Exam question practice

blocks.activity: Choose a topic and review the question command words.
Answer exam-style questions without notes.
Mark answers and note one improvement for each error.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Marked exam-style answers with improvement notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All answers are marked and errors have specific corrections.

sessionTypes.title: Targeted gap review

blocks.activity: Select one gap from the topic tracker.
Review a concise explanation or worked example.
Recall the key points and answer a check question.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief gap summary and a checked answer.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The summary is written from memory and the check answer is reviewed.

sessionTypes.title: Timed exam practice

blocks.activity: Set up a timed question set and required materials.
Complete exam-style questions under timed conditions.
Mark the work and record the next revision target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A timed question set with marks and a next-step target.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The set is completed to time, marked, and one target is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Final focused recall

blocks.activity: Recall priority facts or methods without notes.
Check and correct the recall.
Complete a few confidence-check questions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A corrected priority recall sheet.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The recall is checked and the confidence-check questions are attempted.

phases.title: Build observation habits
phases.focus: Practice seeing simple shapes, proportions, and edges.

phases.title: Develop form and space
phases.focus: Draw objects with volume, perspective, and clear structure.

phases.title: Add light and detail
phases.focus: Use value and texture to make drawings more readable.

phases.title: Compose and refine
phases.focus: Plan a complete drawing, then revise it with intention.

phases.title: Show what you learned
phases.focus: Make one finished drawing and reflect on progress.

sessionTypes.title: Shape and proportion studies

blocks.activity: Choose a simple object and identify its largest shapes.
Draw three quick studies, checking relative widths and heights.
Mark one proportion that improved and one to revisit.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Three small object studies with proportion notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All three studies are complete and each has one note.

sessionTypes.title: Contour and edges

blocks.activity: Set up a simple object and observe its outline.
Draw its contour slowly, then make a second lighter, quicker pass.
Compare the two passes and circle a useful edge.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Two contour drawings of one object.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Both passes are complete and one edge is circled.

sessionTypes.title: Form and perspective

blocks.activity: Sketch boxes, cylinders, and spheres from observation.
Build a small still life from simple forms, checking angles and overlap.
Add construction lines and note the clearest depth cue.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A still-life construction drawing with depth notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The objects read as solid forms and the depth note is written.

sessionTypes.title: Light and value study

blocks.activity: Observe a lit object and identify its lightest and darkest areas.
Draw the object using three clear value groups.
Compare the drawing with the object and adjust one value.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A three-value drawing of one object.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Three value groups are visible and one comparison adjustment is made.

sessionTypes.title: Texture and detail

blocks.activity: Choose a textured object and identify its main surface pattern.
Draw a small study, using marks that describe the surface.
Remove or simplify one detail that distracts from the form.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A texture study with one deliberate simplification.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The surface is recognizable and one distracting detail is simplified.

sessionTypes.title: Composition thumbnails

blocks.activity: Choose two or three objects for a small still life.
Make four thumbnail layouts, varying placement and scale.
Select one layout and mark the focal area.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Four thumbnails with one selected composition.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All thumbnails are complete and the chosen focal area is marked.

sessionTypes.title: Finished observational drawing

blocks.activity: Choose a composition and lightly place the largest shapes.
Develop the drawing with accurate forms, values, and selected details.
Review proportions, edges, and value; make two targeted revisions.
Write one strength and one next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One finished observational drawing with a short reflection.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The drawing is complete, two revisions are visible, and both reflection notes are written.
