phases.title: Build foundations
phases.focus: Review core grammar and everyday vocabulary; establish listening and speaking habits.

phases.title: Expand communication
phases.focus: Build B1 vocabulary and practice longer conversations, reading, and writing.

phases.title: Develop exam skills
phases.focus: Practice timed B1 tasks and strengthen weaker skills.

phases.title: Consolidate and review
phases.focus: Complete exam-style practice, review errors, and improve consistency.

phases.title: Taper
phases.focus: Keep practice light and focused; review key material and exam routines.

sessionTypes.title: Grammar and vocabulary

blocks.activity: Review previous vocabulary with active recall.
Study one grammar point and make example sentences.
Use new words and grammar in a short written response.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A set of example sentences and a short response.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can recall the target words and explain the grammar point using your own examples.

sessionTypes.title: Listening practice

blocks.activity: Preview the topic and note likely key words.
Listen to a German audio clip twice and answer comprehension questions.
Check answers, replay difficult sections, and note useful phrases.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Answered questions and a short list of useful phrases.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can summarize the main points and verify your answers from the audio.

sessionTypes.title: Speaking practice

blocks.activity: Choose a familiar B1 topic and outline key points.
Speak on the topic and record your response.
Practice asking and answering follow-up questions.
Review the recording and note one improvement for next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recorded response and a brief self-review.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You give a connected response with reasons or examples and answer follow-up questions.

sessionTypes.title: Reading and writing

blocks.activity: Read a short German text and identify its main idea and details.
Review useful vocabulary and text structure.
Write a short message or opinion response on a related topic.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Reading notes and a completed short text.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You identify the main points and write a clear response with connected sentences.

sessionTypes.title: B1 exam practice

blocks.activity: Set a timer and prepare the task materials.
Complete a timed B1 exam section or a set of exam-style tasks.
Check answers and record errors with corrections.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Completed timed tasks and an error log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish within the time limit and identify specific corrections for missed items.

sessionTypes.title: Spaced review

blocks.activity: Recall vocabulary and grammar from earlier sessions without notes.
Correct missed items and revisit difficult examples.
Choose the next small review target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Updated review list with corrected examples.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can retrieve the reviewed items and have recorded any remaining gaps.

spec.title: Polish Piano Pieces for the Wedding

phases.title: Choose and assess
phases.focus: Select suitable pieces and identify the passages that need the most work.

phases.title: Build reliable technique
phases.focus: Strengthen difficult passages, fingering, rhythm, and transitions.

phases.title: Shape the music
phases.focus: Refine phrasing, dynamics, tone, and continuity.

phases.title: Perform and polish
phases.focus: Practice complete run-throughs and prepare for performance conditions.

phases.title: Light final review
phases.focus: Keep the pieces fresh with relaxed, focused review.

sessionTypes.title: Score and repertoire review

blocks.activity: Review the score and mark structure, repeats, and transitions.
Check fingering, rhythm, and any uncertain notes.
Play selected sections slowly and note priorities.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Annotated score and a short list of practice priorities.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Every piece has a clear structure map and at least three specific priorities.

sessionTypes.title: Focused passage practice

blocks.activity: Warm up with relaxed scales or patterns related to the pieces.
Practice the hardest passage slowly with consistent fingering.
Repeat the passage in short sections, then join the sections.
Play the passage in context and record remaining issues.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of the target passage and a note of the chosen tempo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The passage is played accurately three times in a row at the session's target tempo.

sessionTypes.title: Phrasing and sound

blocks.activity: Play a gentle warm-up and settle on a comfortable sound.
Shape melody, accompaniment balance, and phrase direction.
Work on dynamics, articulation, and voicing in selected sections.
Record a shaped section and listen for one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording of a section with intentional phrasing and dynamics.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The section has a clear melodic line, balanced accompaniment, and deliberate phrase endings.

sessionTypes.title: Complete run-through

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy patterns and review the opening.
Play the selected program without stopping; note any slips.
Review transitions and recoveries from the run.
Record the run and choose one priority for next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A complete run-through recording with brief notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The full program is played without restarting, and any slips are logged for targeted practice.

sessionTypes.title: Performance simulation

blocks.activity: Set up as for the event and play a short warm-up.
Perform the program straight through as if for an audience.
Review the recording for continuity, pacing, and confidence.
Write one final adjustment for the next practice.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A performance-style recording and one concise adjustment note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The program is completed without stopping and the adjustment is specific and actionable.

sessionTypes.title: Relaxed repertoire review

blocks.activity: Play an easy warm-up at a relaxed pace.
Review selected passages without pushing tempo.
Play favorite sections and note any small reminders.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short list of reminders for the next run-through or performance.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The selected passages feel familiar and the reminders are brief and clear.

phases.title: Notice and choose
phases.focus: Track evening screen use and choose a realistic replacement activity.

phases.title: Build the routine
phases.focus: Set a screen cutoff and use a planned activity in its place.

phases.title: Make it stick
phases.focus: Repeat the routine, adjust obstacles, and review progress.

sessionTypes.title: Evening screen check-in

blocks.activity: Note when evening screen use began and ended.
Record what prompted extra screen time.
Choose one small change for tomorrow evening.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief evening-use log and one change to try.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The log and next-day change are written down.

sessionTypes.title: Plan a screen-free evening

blocks.activity: Choose a time to put screens away.
Pick a specific replacement activity and prepare what it needs.
Write a simple plan for handling the urge to check a screen.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written cutoff time, replacement activity, and backup plan.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All three parts are specific and ready to use.

sessionTypes.title: Try the evening routine

blocks.activity: Set devices aside at the planned cutoff.
Do the chosen screen-free activity.
Record what worked and what got in the way.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed screen-free activity and a short reflection.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The cutoff was attempted, the activity was done, and the reflection is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Review and adjust

blocks.activity: Review the week's evening-use notes.
Identify one success and one recurring obstacle.
Set one practical adjustment for next week.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A weekly summary and one adjustment.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The success, obstacle, and next step are written down.

phases.title: Build a gentle routine
phases.focus: Practice controlled hip mobility and comfortable, pain-free range.

phases.title: Develop range and control
phases.focus: Gradually extend holds while keeping movement relaxed and controlled.

phases.title: Consolidate and ease off
phases.focus: Maintain consistent practice, then reduce volume in the final week.

sessionTypes.title: Hip mobility practice

blocks.activity: Easy dynamic hip circles and leg swings.
Controlled side lunges, alternating sides.
Supported butterfly stretch, relaxed breathing.
Gentle seated straddle, hinge only within a comfortable range.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief note of the stretches practiced and comfort level.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete each block without forcing range or bouncing.

sessionTypes.title: Supported straddle practice

blocks.activity: Easy dynamic hip circles and leg swings.
Controlled side lunges, alternating sides.
Supported wide straddle hold, using hands or cushions as needed.
Supported box-split position, brief comfortable holds on each side.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A note of support height and comfortable hold time.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the holds with steady breathing and no sharp pain.

sessionTypes.title: Relaxed range session

blocks.activity: Gentle dynamic hip movements.

question: ¿Qué habilidad o área te gustaría practicar para avanzar en esa reinvención profesional?

spec.title: Excel avanzado y bases de datos

phases.title: Fundamentos y diagnóstico
phases.focus: Repasar fórmulas, tablas y conceptos básicos de bases de datos.

phases.title: Análisis avanzado en Excel
phases.focus: Practicar búsquedas, tablas dinámicas y limpieza de datos.

phases.title: Bases de datos y consultas
phases.focus: Diseñar tablas y resolver consultas SQL con datos de práctica.

phases.title: Proyecto integrador
phases.focus: Crear y presentar un análisis reproducible con Excel y SQL.

sessionTypes.title: Fórmulas avanzadas

blocks.activity: Repasar referencias y funciones lógicas.
Resolver ejercicios con búsquedas y funciones condicionales.
Comprobar resultados y anotar errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Hoja con cinco ejercicios resueltos y verificados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Las cinco fórmulas devuelven el resultado esperado.

sessionTypes.title: Tablas dinámicas

blocks.activity: Revisar y ordenar un conjunto de datos.
Crear una tabla dinámica con filtros y agrupaciones.
Escribir dos conclusiones basadas en los resultados.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tabla dinámica y dos conclusiones breves.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La tabla responde una pregunta concreta y sus filtros funcionan.

sessionTypes.title: Limpieza de datos

blocks.activity: Detectar valores vacíos, duplicados y formatos inconsistentes.
Limpiar y normalizar los datos en Excel.
Registrar los cambios realizados.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Conjunto de datos limpio y registro de cambios.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: No quedan duplicados identificados y los formatos son coherentes.

sessionTypes.title: Modelo relacional

blocks.activity: Identificar entidades y atributos de un caso sencillo.
Diseñar tablas, claves y relaciones.
Revisar el modelo con ejemplos de registros.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Diagrama sencillo de tablas y relaciones.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Cada tabla tiene una clave y las relaciones están justificadas.

sessionTypes.title: Consultas SQL

blocks.activity: Repasar SELECT, WHERE y ORDER BY.
Practicar filtros, agregaciones y uniones entre tablas.
Ejecutar y corregir las consultas.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Archivo con cinco consultas SQL comentadas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Las consultas se ejecutan y responden las preguntas planteadas.

sessionTypes.title: Proyecto de análisis

blocks.activity: Definir una pregunta y revisar los datos disponibles.
Preparar datos y obtener resultados con SQL o Excel.
Crear una tabla dinámica o visualización clara.
Redactar hallazgos y pasos para reproducir el análisis.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Análisis breve con datos, consultas o fórmulas y hallazgos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Otra persona puede seguir los pasos y verificar los resultados.

question: Which sport would you like to practise?

phases.title: Build a gentle base
phases.focus: Establish easy movement, basic strength and coordination.

phases.title: Build rugby-ready fitness
phases.focus: Gradually extend easy efforts and practise controlled changes of pace.

phases.title: Prepare to join in
phases.focus: Combine steady movement, simple agility and beginner rugby skills.

phases.title: Freshen up
phases.focus: Reduce training and finish feeling ready to attend a beginner session.

sessionTypes.title: Easy walk

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Walk at a comfortable, steady pace.
Slow down and finish easily.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy walk.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish at a pace that lets you speak in full sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Walk-jog intervals

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Alternate 1 minute of relaxed jogging with 2 minutes of walking.
Walk easily to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed set of relaxed walk-jog intervals.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the intervals without sprinting and finish in control.

sessionTypes.title: Basic strength and movement

blocks.activity: March gently and practise comfortable bodyweight squats.
Complete easy rounds of chair squats, wall push-ups, glute bridges and standing calf raises, resting as needed.
Walk slowly and loosen up.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed set of controlled bodyweight movements.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish each movement with steady form and take rests when needed.

sessionTypes.title: Easy agility and ball skills

blocks.activity: Walk and move gently to warm up.
Practise relaxed side steps, forward-and-back steps and gentle direction changes.
Practise simple ball carries and short passes against a wall or with a partner.
Walk easily to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short practice of controlled movement and basic ball handling.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the drills at an easy pace with controlled stops and turns.

sessionTypes.title: Longer easy walk-jog

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Alternate 2 minutes of relaxed jogging with 3 minutes of walking.
Walk easily to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed longer walk-jog session.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You keep the effort comfortable throughout and finish without rushing.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled pace changes

blocks.activity: Walk gently to warm up.
Alternate 1 minute of brisk running with 2 minutes of easy walking.
Practise gentle accelerations and gradual stops.
Walk easily to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed set of controlled pace changes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You keep every faster effort controlled and recover during each walk.

spec.title: Prepare for an Adult Studio Recital

phases.title: Choose and learn
phases.focus: Choose a suitable recital piece, map its sections, and learn small passages slowly.

phases.title: Build the piece
phases.focus: Connect passages, steady the rhythm, and shape the piece with clear phrasing.

phases.title: Rehearse and refine
phases.focus: Practice complete run-throughs, recover calmly from slips, and prepare a simple performance routine.

phases.title: Recital week
phases.focus: Keep practice light and play the piece once with confidence.

sessionTypes.title: Choose and map the piece

blocks.activity: Set up your instrument and settle in.
Review candidate pieces and choose one that feels manageable.
Mark its sections and identify two tricky spots.
Play or speak through the opening slowly.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A chosen piece with section labels and two marked tricky spots.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can name the piece and point to its sections.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a short passage

blocks.activity: Warm up with an easy familiar pattern.
Work slowly on one short passage, noticing notes and fingering.
Repeat the passage in small chunks, then join the chunks.
Play the passage once without stopping.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One short passage practiced and a note of its sticking point.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the passage slowly from start to finish.

sessionTypes.title: Connect neighboring sections

blocks.activity: Warm up with a comfortable pattern.
Review the first section slowly.
Practice the transition into the next section.
Play both sections together at a steady, comfortable pace.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A connected pair of sections and one transition note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can move between the sections without losing your place.

sessionTypes.title: Shape phrasing and rhythm

blocks.activity: Set a comfortable tempo and warm up.
Clap or count the rhythm in a tricky passage.
Practice the passage slowly with even timing.
Play a phrase and choose one place to shape its sound.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked phrase and a steady version of one tricky rhythm.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can count the rhythm and play the phrase with one intentional shape.

sessionTypes.title: Complete run-through

blocks.activity: Set up and take a calm breath.
Review the two most challenging spots slowly.
Play the whole piece without stopping.
Write down one success and one next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A complete run-through and a brief practice note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish the piece without restarting, even if you make a small slip.

sessionTypes.title: Practice performing

blocks.activity: Arrange your space as if for a recital.
Practice entering, settling, and beginning.
Play the piece for a listener or make a simple recording.
Practice continuing calmly after an intentional pause or slip.
Note one thing that felt confident.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recital-style run-through and one confidence note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the performance routine and keep going through a small mistake.

sessionTypes.title: Light recital-week recap

blocks.activity: Settle in and play an easy warm-up.
Review one tricky passage slowly.
Play the piece once at a comfortable pace.
Close by noting one thing you are ready to share.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One relaxed run-through and a readiness note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish the piece once without turning the session into a correction marathon.

phases.title: Settle into front crawl
phases.focus: Practice relaxed breathing, body position, and short crawl repeats.

phases.title: Build repeatable lengths
phases.focus: Extend easy repeats while keeping breathing controlled.

phases.title: Swim longer with ease
phases.focus: Link longer crawl efforts, then reduce volume in the final week.

sessionTypes.title: Breath and balance

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up in a comfortable stroke.
Practice relaxed bubbles and turning to breathe at the wall.
Swim short, easy front-crawl repeats with plenty of rest.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A note of which breathing side felt more relaxed.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish all repeats without rushing the breath.

sessionTypes.title: Short crawl repeats

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up.
Alternate short front-crawl swims with relaxed rest at the wall.
Easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: The longest relaxed crawl repeat completed.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the repeats while keeping breathing calm.

sessionTypes.title: Steady crawl practice

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up.
Swim front-crawl repeats, gradually lengthening each repeat with rest as needed.
Easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A record of the longest controlled crawl repeat.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the main set without sprinting or losing breathing control.

sessionTypes.title: Easy mixed swim

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up in a comfortable stroke.
Alternate easy front crawl and a comfortable recovery stroke.
Easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A note of the crawl intervals that felt smooth.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish at an easy effort with relaxed breathing.

sessionTypes.title: Longer crawl repeats

blocks.activity: Easy warm-up.
Swim front-crawl repeats, building toward longer lengths with relaxed rests.
Easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: The longest front-crawl length completed with controlled breathing.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the main set without forcing the pace.

sessionTypes.title: Easy recovery swim

blocks.activity: Very easy warm-up.
Swim easy short repeats in a comfortable stroke.
Easy cool-down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief note on how the swim felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish feeling comfortable and unhurried.

phases.title: Crear el hábito
phases.focus: Establecer salidas matutinas y una base de carrera cómoda.

phases.title: Construir resistencia
phases.focus: Aumentar gradualmente el tiempo de carrera y practicar ritmos controlados.

phases.title: Desarrollar fondo
phases.focus: Consolidar la resistencia con una salida larga semanal y rodajes fáciles.

phases.title: Afinar y recuperar
phases.focus: Mantener la constancia, reducir la carga y llegar con energía.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje fácil

blocks.activity: Camina y trota suavemente para entrar en calor.
Corre a un ritmo cómodo, pudiendo hablar.
Camina para volver a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro del tiempo y la sensación del esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas los 20 minutos sin forzar el ritmo.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje de base

blocks.activity: Camina y trota suavemente para entrar en calor.
Corre a ritmo fácil y conversacional.
Camina para volver a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro del tiempo y la distancia recorrida.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Terminas el rodaje manteniendo un esfuerzo cómodo.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje largo fácil

blocks.activity: Camina y trota suavemente para entrar en calor.
Corre a ritmo fácil; alterna trote y caminata si lo necesitas.
Camina para volver a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro del tiempo y la distancia del rodaje.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas el tiempo previsto a un esfuerzo sostenible.

sessionTypes.title: Intervalos controlados

blocks.activity: Trota suavemente para entrar en calor.
Alterna 4 veces 2 minutos ágiles y 2 minutos fáciles.
Trota o camina para volver a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro de las cuatro repeticiones y del esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas las cuatro repeticiones sin esprintar.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje progresivo suave

blocks.activity: Trota suavemente para entrar en calor.
Empieza fácil y aumenta ligeramente el ritmo, sin llegar a esfuerzo máximo.
Camina para volver a la calma.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro de cómo cambió el ritmo durante el rodaje.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Acabas con control y sin acelerar al máximo.

sessionTypes.title: Fondo fácil

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro del tiempo, la distancia y el esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas el tiempo previsto a ritmo fácil.

phases.title: Base y técnica
phases.focus: Consolidar carrera fácil, giros y cambios de ritmo controlados.

phases.title: Progresión específica
phases.focus: Aumentar gradualmente las series y el trabajo de navette.

phases.title: Puesta a punto
phases.focus: Practicar periodos altos y reducir la carga antes de la prueba.

phases.title: Evaluación
phases.focus: Llegar descansado y comprobar el progreso en la course navette.

sessionTypes.title: Carrera fácil y técnica

blocks.activity: Caminar y trotar suavemente.
Correr a ritmo cómodo.
Practicar giros controlados y caminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de minutos y giros practicados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa los bloques manteniendo un ritmo cómodo.

sessionTypes.title: Series de navette

blocks.activity: Trote suave y movilidad dinámica.
Hacer intervalos de navette de 1 minuto, con 1 minuto suave entre ellos.
Caminar y anotar los intervalos completados.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Número de intervalos completados y ritmo percibido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa los intervalos previstos sin perder el control de los giros.

sessionTypes.title: Fartlek progresivo

blocks.activity: Trote suave.
Alternar 1 minuto vivo y 2 minutos suaves.
Trote muy suave y caminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de cambios de ritmo completados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa las alternancias manteniendo los tramos vivos controlados.

sessionTypes.title: Práctica de periodos altos

blocks.activity: Trote suave y movilidad dinámica.
Practicar navette por bloques, aumentando gradualmente el ritmo y descansando suavemente entre bloques.
Caminar y registrar el último periodo completado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Último periodo completado y notas sobre los giros.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa el trabajo previsto sin forzar repeticiones adicionales.

sessionTypes.title: Prueba de course navette

blocks.activity: Trote suave y movilidad dinámica.
Realizar la course navette a ritmo progresivo y detenerse al no poder mantener las señales.
Caminar y anotar el periodo alcanzado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Periodo alcanzado y observaciones sobre el ritmo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Registra el resultado de la prueba y termina caminando.

spec.title: Train for an XC Mountain Bike Race

phases.title: Aerobic base
phases.focus: Build consistent endurance and establish controlled strength work.

phases.title: Strength and climbing
phases.focus: Develop sustained climbing power and steady aerobic volume.

phases.title: Race-specific build
phases.focus: Add threshold efforts, technical riding, and race-pace endurance.

phases.title: Peak
phases.focus: Sharpen race efforts while keeping endurance and strength consistent.

phases.title: Taper
phases.focus: Reduce volume, retain brief intensity, and arrive fresh.

sessionTypes.title: Easy commute spin

blocks.activity: Ride gently and settle into a relaxed cadence.
Spin easily on flat or familiar roads.
Ease off and finish relaxed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy ride with relaxed effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish able to speak comfortably throughout.

sessionTypes.title: Endurance ride

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy pedaling.
Ride steadily at a conversational pace on mixed terrain.
Cool down with light pedaling.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A steady endurance ride on mixed terrain.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all blocks without turning the ride into a hard effort.

sessionTypes.title: Long trail endurance

blocks.activity: Warm up easily on smooth terrain.
Ride trails steadily, keeping climbs controlled and practicing smooth handling.
Cool down at an easy pace.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A long, controlled trail ride.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the planned time with steady effort and composed handling.

sessionTypes.title: Climbing intervals

blocks.activity: Warm up easily, including a few short cadence increases.
Complete 4 rounds of 3 minutes hard uphill and 3 minutes easy.
Ride easily on rolling terrain.
Cool down gently.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Four controlled uphill efforts with recoveries.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all four efforts at strong, repeatable intensity.

sessionTypes.title: Threshold intervals

blocks.activity: Warm up progressively with easy pedaling.
Complete 3 rounds of 6 minutes hard and 2 minutes easy.
Ride easily and smoothly.
Cool down gently.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Three sustained threshold efforts.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete each effort at a strong, even pace without fading sharply.

sessionTypes.title: Race-pace trail session

blocks.activity: Warm up on easy terrain.
Ride 3 rounds of 6 minutes at race effort and 4 minutes easy.
Ride technical trail smoothly at moderate effort.
Cool down easily.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A race-specific trail session with repeatable hard efforts.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all rounds and technical riding with controlled pacing.

sessionTypes.title: Cycling strength

blocks.activity: Warm up with mobility and easy bodyweight movements.
Complete controlled sets of squats, hip hinges, step-ups, and core stability.
Finish with light mobility and relaxed movement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed strength session with controlled repetitions.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish every planned set with stable form and no rushed repetitions.

spec.title: Preparar la certificación C1 de inglés

phases.title: Diagnóstico y bases
phases.focus: Detectar lagunas y consolidar gramática C1 y escritura argumentativa.

phases.title: Desarrollo de destrezas
phases.focus: Practicar estructuras avanzadas, textos variados y tareas cronometradas.

phases.title: Simulacros y repaso
phases.focus: Integrar destrezas con simulacros, corregir errores recurrentes y afinar estrategias.

phases.title: Repaso ligero
phases.focus: Consolidar lo aprendido con práctica breve y sin sobrecarga.

sessionTypes.title: Gramática avanzada

blocks.activity: Repasar una estructura C1 y sus usos.
Resolver ejercicios y crear ejemplos propios.
Anotar errores y reglas clave.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de ejemplos y errores corregidos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has completado los ejercicios y explicado tus errores.

sessionTypes.title: Escritura guiada

blocks.activity: Analizar la consigna y planificar la estructura.
Redactar un texto de estilo C1.
Revisar gramática, cohesión y registro.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un texto revisado con cambios identificables.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: El texto responde a la consigna y has corregido al menos tres aspectos.

sessionTypes.title: Lectura y vocabulario

blocks.activity: Leer un texto de nivel C1 y responder preguntas.
Registrar expresiones útiles con ejemplos.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Respuestas y una lista de expresiones contextualizadas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has respondido las preguntas y anotado cinco expresiones.

sessionTypes.title: Comprensión auditiva

blocks.activity: Escuchar un audio C1 y tomar notas.
Comprobar respuestas y revisar lo que no entendiste.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Notas del audio y registro de respuestas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has revisado cada respuesta y resumido el audio en tres frases.

sessionTypes.title: Tarea cronometrada

blocks.activity: Leer instrucciones y distribuir el tiempo.
Completar una tarea de examen sin interrupciones.
Corregir y clasificar los errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una tarea terminada y una lista de errores.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has respetado el tiempo y anotado tres prioridades de mejora.

sessionTypes.title: Simulacro parcial

blocks.activity: Completar una sección de examen en condiciones cronometradas.
Revisar respuestas y justificar correcciones.
Registrar el resultado y el siguiente objetivo.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una sección completada, corregida y puntuada.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has registrado el resultado y dos errores recurrentes.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso de errores

blocks.activity: Revisar errores guardados y rehacer ejemplos.
Escribir una regla o estrategia para cada error.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un registro actualizado de errores y soluciones.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Has rehecho los ejemplos sin consultar las respuestas.

phases.title: Build a running base
phases.focus: Establish three easy, consistent runs while keeping CrossFit separate.

phases.title: Build endurance
phases.focus: Gradually extend the long run and add controlled marathon-pace work.

phases.title: Marathon-specific training
phases.focus: Develop sustained endurance with easy runs, steady work, and longer runs.

phases.title: Taper
phases.focus: Reduce running volume while retaining relaxed, purposeful running.

sessionTypes.title: Easy run

blocks.activity: Walk briskly and ease into a relaxed jog.
Run at a conversational effort.
Jog easily, then walk to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy run and brief effort note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish at a conversational effort without pushing the pace.

sessionTypes.title: Steady run

blocks.activity: Jog easily to warm up.
Run steadily at a controlled, sustainable effort.
Jog easily to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A steady run with the middle section completed at controlled effort.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the steady section without turning it into a hard effort.

sessionTypes.title: Long easy run

blocks.activity: Walk briskly and ease into a relaxed jog.
Run easily at a conversational effort.
Jog easily, then walk to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed long easy run and effort note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the full time at an easy, conversational effort.

question: What would you like to learn?

phases.title: Start small
phases.focus: Build a low-pressure drawing habit with short, finished exercises.

phases.title: Observe and shape
phases.focus: Practice seeing simple forms, proportions, and light.

phases.title: Make a small portfolio
phases.focus: Combine skills in personal drawings and finish with a lighter review week.

sessionTypes.title: Lines and shapes

blocks.activity: Draw loose lines and circles.
Fill a page with boxes, ellipses, and simple forms.
Circle three shapes that feel most controlled.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One page of line and shape exercises.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The page is filled and three shapes are marked.

sessionTypes.title: Everyday object study

blocks.activity: Choose one simple object and observe its outline.
Draw the object, checking its proportions against the reference.
Add a few details and note one improvement for next time.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One observational drawing with a brief improvement note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The object is recognizable and the note is written.

sessionTypes.title: Form and shadow

blocks.activity: Set up a sphere, box, or cylinder under a clear light.
Sketch the form and its cast shadow.
Add three distinct value areas.
Compare the drawing with the setup and mark one adjustment.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A shaded study of one simple form.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The form has an outline, cast shadow, and three value areas.

sessionTypes.title: Small composition

blocks.activity: Choose two or three objects to arrange.
Make three tiny layout sketches.
Develop the clearest layout into a drawing.
Write one sentence about what draws the eye.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One composition drawing and three thumbnail layouts.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The drawing is complete and the sentence is written.

sessionTypes.title: Personal drawing

blocks.activity: Choose a subject you are curious about.
Make two quick thumbnail sketches.
Create a finished drawing using observation and simple forms.
Title the drawing and note one thing learned.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A titled personal drawing with a learning note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The drawing is finished, titled, and has one learning note.

sessionTypes.title: Review and redraw

blocks.activity: Choose an earlier drawing to revisit.
Redraw the subject, focusing on one specific improvement.
Compare both versions and record what changed.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A redraw beside the original and a short comparison.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Both drawings are compared and one change is recorded.

spec.title: Ganar fondo en bicicleta de montaña

phases.title: Base suave
phases.focus: Acumular tiempo pedaleando en terreno plano a ritmo cómodo.

phases.title: Construcción
phases.focus: Alargar gradualmente la salida suave y añadir una sesión intensa controlada.

phases.title: Consolidación
phases.focus: Sostener el fondo con esfuerzo estable y una sesión intensa semanal.

phases.title: Descarga
phases.focus: Reducir el volumen y terminar con una salida fácil.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje suave en llano

blocks.activity: Pedalea muy suave para entrar en ritmo.
Pedalea en terreno plano a ritmo cómodo y constante.
Afloja el ritmo para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro del tiempo y del esfuerzo percibido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas los 30 minutos pudiendo conversar.

sessionTypes.title: Salida de fondo fácil

blocks.activity: Pedalea suave para calentar.

Pedalea suave para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro del tiempo y del esfuerzo percibido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Terminas a ritmo conversacional, sin esprintar en las subidas.

sessionTypes.title: Intervalos controlados

blocks.activity: Calienta pedaleando suave.

Recupera pedaleando muy suave.
Pedalea suave para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de los intervalos y del esfuerzo percibido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas dos intervalos sin llegar al máximo y recuperas entre ellos.

question: What would you like to practise or get better at?

phases.title: Get comfortable
phases.focus: Build a low-pressure evening routine; learn keyboard layout, posture, and basic rhythm.

phases.title: Play simple patterns
phases.focus: Practice steady hands-together patterns and learn a short, approachable piece.

phases.title: Finish and share a piece
phases.focus: Polish the piece, play it from start to finish, and make a simple recording.

sessionTypes.title: Gentle piano warm-up

blocks.activity: Find and name groups of two and three black keys.
Tap a steady beat, then play a few comfortable single notes.
Review one familiar pattern slowly.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short note naming the keys or pattern reviewed.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have completed each block without rushing.

sessionTypes.title: Keys and steady rhythm

blocks.activity: Locate middle C and nearby white keys.
Play a five-note pattern slowly, one hand at a time.
Clap and count a simple four-beat rhythm.
Play the pattern with an even beat.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A five-note pattern played with a steady pulse.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the pattern three times at a comfortable pace.

sessionTypes.title: Read and play a short melody

blocks.activity: Review the keyboard landmarks and hand position.
Read a few beginner notes from a simple score or lesson.
Learn a short melody in small phrases, hands separately.
Join the phrases and mark any tricky spot.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short melody played in connected phrases.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the melody slowly from beginning to end.

sessionTypes.title: Coordinate both hands

blocks.activity: Warm up with the familiar five-note pattern.
Practice the melody with the right hand, slowly.
Practice a simple left-hand note or chord pattern.
Combine both hands in short sections, then link them.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short section played with both hands.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the section slowly three times with both hands.

sessionTypes.title: Learn and polish a short piece

blocks.activity: Warm up with an easy familiar pattern.
Practice the first section hands separately.
Practice the next section hands separately.
Join sections hands together at a slow, steady pace.
Play through once and note one next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked practice copy and a complete slow play-through.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the whole piece once and identified one spot to improve.

sessionTypes.title: Run-through and recording

blocks.activity: Settle in and play a familiar warm-up.
Review the piece's transitions and ending.
Play the piece from start to finish without stopping.
Make a simple recording or write a brief reflection.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A complete run-through and a recording or short reflection.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the piece through once and saved a recording or reflection.

spec.title: Preparación para una milla en calle

phases.title: Base y técnica
phases.focus: Mantener la base aeróbica y practicar velocidad controlada.

phases.title: Velocidad específica
phases.focus: Desarrollar ritmo de milla sin descuidar la resistencia.

phases.title: Afinación
phases.focus: Consolidar el ritmo de carrera y sostener la base para 5K y 10K.

phases.title: Descarga
phases.focus: Llegar fresco con una sesión breve y ágil.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje fácil

blocks.activity: Corre a ritmo cómodo y conversacional.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Rodaje completado con esfuerzo uniforme.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Terminas pudiendo hablar en frases completas.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje de base

blocks.activity: Corre a ritmo cómodo y constante.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Rodaje aeróbico sostenido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas el tiempo sin acelerar el esfuerzo.

sessionTypes.title: Rodaje largo

blocks.activity: Corre suave y constante para mantener la resistencia.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Rodaje largo completado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Mantienes un ritmo conversacional durante toda la sesión.

sessionTypes.title: Intervalos para la milla

blocks.activity: Trote suave de calentamiento.
Corre 6 repeticiones de 1 minuto rápido, con 90 segundos de trote suave entre repeticiones.
Trote suave de recuperación.
Anota sensaciones y ritmo aproximado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Seis repeticiones rápidas registradas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas las seis repeticiones con técnica controlada.

sessionTypes.title: Ritmo de milla

blocks.activity: Trote suave de calentamiento.
Corre 4 repeticiones de 3 minutos a ritmo objetivo de milla, con 2 minutos suaves entre ellas.
Trote suave de recuperación.

sessionTypes.title: Easy endurance ride

blocks.activity: Ride gently to warm up.
Ride at a relaxed, steady pace.
Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A relaxed ride with total time recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish able to speak in full sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Steady endurance ride

blocks.activity: Ride gently to warm up.
Ride steadily at a comfortable pace.
Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A steady ride with time and distance recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the ride without straining and can speak in full sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled hill practice

blocks.activity: Ride easily to warm up.
Climb at a controlled, steady effort.
Ride easily to recover.
Climb at a controlled, steady effort.
Ride easily on rolling or flat terrain.
Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Two controlled climbs and a note on how each felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Both climbs are completed without sprinting or losing control of the effort.

sessionTypes.title: Long easy ride

sessionTypes.title: Sustained climbing ride

Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Two sustained climbs with effort notes.

sessionTypes.title: Hilly commute simulation

blocks.activity: Ride gently to warm up.

Ride gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A steady ride with two climbs and a record of how fresh you felt afterward.

phases.title: Build accurate habits
phases.focus: Practice relaxed posture, home-row reach, and steady accuracy before increasing pace.

phases.title: Build speed
phases.focus: Add short, controlled speed drills while keeping accuracy consistent.

phases.title: Apply and consolidate
phases.focus: Practice varied text, check progress, and finish with a light review.

sessionTypes.title: Accuracy and home-row drills

blocks.activity: Record a one-minute typing baseline and note errors.
Type home-row patterns slowly, focusing on correct finger placement.
Practice common letter pairs and short words at a comfortable pace.
Retype a short passage and record accuracy.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short passage with recorded accuracy and error notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete every block without looking at the keyboard; prioritize correct keystrokes.

sessionTypes.title: Steady passage practice

blocks.activity: Warm up with familiar words at an easy pace.
Type an unfamiliar passage steadily without looking at the keyboard.
Review errors and identify one recurring pattern.
Retype the passage section that contained the most errors.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A passage attempt with words per minute, accuracy, and one error pattern.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish the passage and record both speed and accuracy.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled speed intervals

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy, accurate typing.
Complete three short speed attempts, returning to an easy pace between attempts.
Review speed and accuracy for each attempt.
Repeat the weakest attempt at a controlled pace.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Three timed attempts with speed and accuracy recorded.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all attempts and keep each one readable; note where accuracy drops.

sessionTypes.title: Mixed-text practice

blocks.activity: Warm up with familiar text.
Type prose with punctuation at a steady pace.
Practice numbers, symbols, and less familiar letter combinations.
Review errors and note one key to practice.
Retype a short section using the noted key accurately.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A mixed-text sample and a brief list of recurring errors.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete each text section without looking at the keyboard and record accuracy.

sessionTypes.title: Typing progress check

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy typing.
Type a fresh passage under consistent timed conditions.
Record words per minute and accuracy.
Review errors and compare results with the previous check.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A timed passage result and a comparison with the previous check.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Record speed and accuracy using the same measurement method as before.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a core concept

blocks.activity: Recall prior material and set one learning goal.
Study one programming concept with examples.
Write a small example and note questions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A runnable example and concise concept notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The example runs and you can explain the concept in your own words.

sessionTypes.title: Focused coding practice

blocks.activity: Choose a small problem and outline an approach.
Implement the solution without copying a walkthrough.
Test edge cases and record one improvement.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A tested solution with a short explanation.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The solution passes your tests and you can describe its approach.

sessionTypes.title: Project build session

blocks.activity: Pick one small project task and define its acceptance check.
Implement the task in the project.
Run checks, fix a defect, and save a clear commit.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A working project increment with a meaningful commit.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The acceptance check passes and the change is committed.

sessionTypes.title: Debug and review

blocks.activity: Review notes and select one confusing point.
Reproduce and investigate a bug or revisit a difficult exercise.
Write the cause, fix, and a prevention note.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief debugging note or corrected exercise.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can state what was wrong and verify the fix.

sessionTypes.title: Career preparation

blocks.activity: Review one developer job description.
Improve a resume bullet, project README, or interview answer.
Save the revision and list the next action.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One improved application or interview-preparation artifact.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The revision is saved and tied to a specific role requirement.

phases.title: Ease back in

phases.title: Build endurance
phases.focus: Gradually lengthen easy running intervals while keeping the effort controlled.

phases.title: Consolidate
phases.focus: Practice longer easy running intervals, then ease off in the final week.

sessionTypes.title: Easy run-walk

blocks.activity: Walk briskly to warm up.
Alternate 1 minute easy jogging and 1 minute walking.

phases.title: Settle into the routine
phases.focus: Build a repeatable easy, hard, and steady bike routine around recovery.

phases.title: Build bike fitness
phases.focus: Gradually extend easy riding and controlled hard efforts.

phases.title: Consolidate and ease off
phases.focus: Hold fitness with manageable rides, then finish with a short easy ride.

sessionTypes.title: Easy bike spin

blocks.activity: Ride very easily to warm up.
Pedal at a relaxed pace; keep effort conversational.
Spin gently to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy ride and a brief effort note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish all 25 minutes at a conversational effort.

sessionTypes.title: Steady bike ride

blocks.activity: Ride easily to warm up.
Ride steadily at a controlled pace.
Pedal easily to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed steady ride and a note on how controlled it felt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete the ride without turning the steady section into a hard effort.

sessionTypes.title: Controlled bike intervals

blocks.activity: Warm up with easy pedaling.
Repeat 3 times: 1 minute hard, then 4 minutes easy.
Ride easily to cool down.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Three controlled hard efforts and a short effort note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Complete all three efforts with easy recovery between them.

sessionTypes.title: Long easy bike ride

blocks.activity: Start with gentle pedaling.
Ride easily at a conversational pace.
Spin gently to finish.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed easy endurance ride and a note on duration.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Finish all 45 minutes without pushing the pace.

blocks.activity: Warm up with gentle pedaling.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed 55-minute easy ride and an effort note.

phases.title: Choose and prepare
phases.focus: Pick a few manageable gifts, check patterns and materials, and make a small test swatch.

phases.title: Build the first gift
phases.focus: Knit the simplest gift first, checking fit and progress as you go.

phases.title: Finish and assess
phases.focus: Complete and finish the first gift, then use remaining time for another small gift if realistic.

sessionTypes.title: Gift and pattern planning

blocks.activity: List recipients and possible gifts.
Choose a simple pattern and check its estimated effort.
Write a materials and deadline checklist.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A ranked gift list with one chosen first project.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The first gift, pattern, and materials are recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Swatch and setup

blocks.activity: Gather yarn, needles, and pattern.
Knit a small test swatch or practice the main stitch.
Note needle size and any pattern questions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A test swatch and setup notes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The swatch is made and the project is ready to begin.

sessionTypes.title: Focused knitting

blocks.activity: Review the next pattern steps.
Knit steadily on the current gift.
Mark progress and note the next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A measurable section of the gift and a progress note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The planned section is complete and the next step is clear.

sessionTypes.title: Finish and review

blocks.activity: Check the piece against the pattern.
Complete a finishing step, such as weaving in ends.
Record what remains and estimate whether another gift fits.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A checked, tidied gift or a clear finishing checklist.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The gift is finished or its remaining work is listed.

phases.title: Set a balanced routine
phases.focus: Establish a repeatable technique-and-song practice habit.

phases.title: Build fluency
phases.focus: Improve clean technique and learn songs in manageable sections.

phases.title: Connect and perform
phases.focus: Join sections, refine musical details, and play through songs.

sessionTypes.title: Technique and timing

blocks.activity: Warm up with relaxed fretting and picking.
Practice a scale or chord-change pattern slowly and cleanly.
Repeat the pattern with a metronome, keeping an even pulse.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording of the pattern at a comfortable tempo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You play it evenly with clear notes and relaxed movement.

sessionTypes.title: Learn a song section

blocks.activity: Review the song's chords, rhythm, or tab for today's section.
Learn a small phrase or chord sequence slowly.
Repeat it with the recording or a metronome at a manageable tempo.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A marked-up song section and a short play-through recording.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You play the section through twice without stopping.

sessionTypes.title: Song review and expression

blocks.activity: Tune and review the song's structure.
Play familiar sections slowly, focusing on clean transitions.
Play again with attention to dynamics and phrasing.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A recording with one note about a musical detail to improve.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the selected sections without losing the pulse.

sessionTypes.title: Creative guitar play

blocks.activity: Choose a chord progression or a few notes from a song.
Explore a simple variation in rhythm, melody, or dynamics.
Record a short idea and give it a name.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short recording of an original variation.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You capture one idea you would enjoy revisiting.

sessionTypes.title: Song play-through

blocks.activity: Warm up with the song's main chords or riff.
Play the song from start to finish, noting any rough spots.
Repeat the hardest transition or phrase, then finish with a relaxed run-through.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A full-song recording and a brief list of rough spots.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You finish the song without stopping, even if a few notes are imperfect.

sessionTypes.title: Light review

blocks.activity: Review a familiar chord shape or riff slowly.
Play a favorite song section at an easy tempo.
Write down one thing that feels more comfortable now.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief practice note and a relaxed play-through.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the review without rushing or forcing speed.

phases.title: Find the story
phases.focus: Choose a premise, shape a simple plot, and build a steady writing habit.

phases.title: Build momentum
phases.focus: Draft scenes consistently and review progress against a realistic word-count target.

sessionTypes.title: Story seed

blocks.activity: List fiction ideas and choose one premise.
Write the protagonist's goal, obstacle, and stakes.
Draft a one-paragraph story pitch.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A one-paragraph pitch with a protagonist, goal, obstacle, and stakes.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The pitch is written and the central conflict is clear.

sessionTypes.title: Plot map

blocks.activity: Name the opening situation and inciting event.
List 8 to 12 major story beats in order.
Choose the next scene and note its purpose.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short beat list and a clear next-scene note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The story has a beginning, turning points, and an ending direction.

sessionTypes.title: Drafting sprint

blocks.activity: Set a scene goal and silence distractions.
Draft fiction without editing.
Record the word count and leave a note for the next scene.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A new scene draft and a recorded word count.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The sprint is complete, the count is logged, and the next step is noted.

sessionTypes.title: Progress check

blocks.activity: Log words written and compare with the personal target.
Identify one obstacle and one practical adjustment.
Choose the next scene and set a small writing target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: An updated word-count log and a specific next-session target.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Progress is recorded and the next writing step is chosen.

phases.title: Base técnica
phases.focus: Practicar dominadas limpias y fortalecer el tirón sin llegar al fallo.

phases.title: Construcción
phases.focus: Aumentar gradualmente las repeticiones y el trabajo de fuerza.

phases.title: Consolidación y prueba
phases.focus: Consolidar series de calidad, reducir carga y probar una serie máxima.

sessionTypes.title: Práctica de dominadas

blocks.activity: Movilidad de hombros y activación escapular.
Haz 5 series de 2 dominadas limpias; descansa 2 minutos entre series.
Anota repeticiones y calidad de cada serie.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de cinco series de dominadas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa las cinco series sin balanceo ni llegar al fallo.

sessionTypes.title: Fuerza de tirón

blocks.activity: Calentamiento de hombros y espalda.
Haz 3 rondas de 8 remos y 5 descensos controlados desde la barra.
Registra rondas y control de los descensos.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de rondas y descensos controlados.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa tres rondas con técnica estable y sin dolor.

sessionTypes.title: Volumen de dominadas

blocks.activity: Movilidad de hombros y activación escapular.
Haz 6 series de 2 dominadas; descansa 2 minutos y conserva repeticiones en reserva.
Anota el total de repeticiones y la técnica.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Total de dominadas y notas de técnica.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa seis series con repeticiones limpias y sin llegar al fallo.

sessionTypes.title: Progresión de dominadas

blocks.activity: Calentamiento de hombros y espalda.
Haz 5 series dejando 1 o 2 repeticiones en reserva; descansa 2 a 3 minutos.
Registra las repeticiones de cada serie.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de repeticiones por serie.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa cinco series con técnica estricta y sin fallo.

sessionTypes.title: Tirón ligero y control

blocks.activity: Movilidad suave de hombros.
Haz 3 series de 8 remos fáciles y 3 series de 8 retracciones escapulares.
Anota cómo se sintió el movimiento.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro breve de ejercicios y sensaciones.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa el trabajo con esfuerzo fácil y movimientos controlados.

sessionTypes.title: Prueba de dominadas

blocks.activity: Calentamiento progresivo de hombros y espalda.
Haz una serie máxima de dominadas estrictas.
Registra el resultado y descansa; no añadas más series exigentes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Número de dominadas estrictas consecutivas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa una serie máxima con técnica estricta y registra el resultado.

sessions.title: Volumen de dominadas

blocks.activity: Movilidad de hombros y activación escapular.
Haz 6 series de 2 dominadas; descansa 2 minutos y conserva repeticiones en reserva.
Anota el total de repeticiones y la técnica.

sessions.deliverable: Total de dominadas y notas de técnica.
sessions.doneWhen: Completa seis series con repeticiones limpias y sin llegar al fallo.

sessions.title: Tirón ligero y control

blocks.activity: Movilidad suave de hombros.
Haz 3 series de 8 remos fáciles y 3 series de 8 retracciones escapulares.
Anota cómo se sintió el movimiento.

sessions.deliverable: Registro breve de ejercicios y sensaciones.
sessions.doneWhen: Completa el trabajo con esfuerzo fácil y movimientos controlados.

sessions.title: Prueba de dominadas

blocks.activity: Calentamiento progresivo de hombros y espalda.
Haz una serie máxima de dominadas estrictas.
Registra el resultado y descansa; no añadas más series exigentes.

sessions.deliverable: Número de dominadas estrictas consecutivas.
sessions.doneWhen: Completa una serie máxima con técnica estricta y registra el resultado.

spec.title: Build a Steady Guitar Practice Habit

phases.title: Start the routine
phases.focus: Build a comfortable, repeatable practice habit with short, focused sessions.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Strengthen basic technique and make steady progress on a simple song.

phases.title: Play it through
phases.focus: Connect the skills, play a complete piece, and finish with a lighter week.

sessionTypes.title: Chord changes

blocks.activity: Tune the guitar and settle into a relaxed posture.
Practice changing between two familiar chords slowly.
Strum a steady pattern while changing chords.
Note which change felt smoother.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short record of the chord pair and the smoothest change.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have practiced the pair slowly and strummed through it steadily.

sessionTypes.title: Steady strumming

blocks.activity: Tune and play open strings with relaxed downstrokes.
Strum a simple down-up pattern at an even pace.
Keep the pattern going while switching between two chords.
Write down the pattern you practiced.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A written strumming pattern and chord pair.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can keep the pattern going for one minute without stopping.

sessionTypes.title: Build a song section

blocks.activity: Tune and review the chords used in your chosen beginner song.
Practice one short song section slowly.
Repeat the section with a steady strum.
Mark the tricky spot and your next practice target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A practiced song section with one next-step note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can play the section through slowly, even if a few changes are imperfect.

sessionTypes.title: Finger coordination

blocks.activity: Tune and place each fretting finger gently on a string.
Practice a simple one-finger-at-a-time pattern across nearby frets.
Play the pattern slowly on two strings with clear notes.
Record which notes sounded clearest.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short note on the clearest notes and the practiced pattern.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the pattern slowly with each note ringing clearly.

sessionTypes.title: Play the whole song

blocks.activity: Tune and review the song's chord sequence.
Practice the opening and its chord changes slowly.
Play the complete song at a comfortable, steady pace.
Write down one improvement and one next target.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A complete play-through and a brief progress note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have played the whole song from start to finish at a comfortable pace.

phases.title: Base y técnica
phases.focus: Crear una rutina de fuerza con movimientos controlados y cargas cómodas.

phases.title: Progresión gradual
phases.focus: Aumentar poco a poco el trabajo, manteniendo la técnica y el esfuerzo moderado.

phases.title: Consolidación
phases.focus: Repetir sesiones consistentes y afianzar los movimientos.

phases.title: Descarga
phases.focus: Reducir el volumen y cerrar el plan con una sesión cómoda.

sessionTypes.title: Fuerza de cuerpo completo

blocks.activity: Movilidad suave de cadera, hombros y tobillos.
Sentarse y levantarse de una silla y puente de glúteos, con control.
Flexiones inclinadas y remo con banda o mochila ligera.
Bisagra de cadera sin carga y elevaciones de talones.
Respiración tranquila y repaso de sensaciones.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de ejercicios, repeticiones y esfuerzo percibido.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa los bloques con movimientos controlados y sin forzar.

sessionTypes.title: Fuerza de tren superior

blocks.activity: Movilidad suave de hombros y brazos.
Flexiones inclinadas, en series cómodas.
Remo con banda o mochila ligera y press por encima de la cabeza sin dolor.
Anota el esfuerzo y relaja los hombros.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registro de series y repeticiones de empuje y tracción.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Termina las series dejando varias repeticiones posibles.

sessionTypes.title: Movilidad y control

blocks.activity: Marcha suave en el sitio.
Movilidad cómoda de cadera y columna torácica, más equilibrio junto a un apoyo.
Respiración tranquila y registro de sensaciones.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Nota breve sobre movilidad y equilibrio.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completa los movimientos sin prisa y con control.

spec.title: Escribir el primer borrador de una novela de aventuras

phases.title: Preparación
phases.focus: Definir la premisa, el protagonista y el destino de la aventura.

phases.title: Arranque
phases.focus: Escribir el inicio y poner en marcha el conflicto.

phases.title: Travesía
phases.focus: Avanzar la trama con obstáculos, decisiones y descubrimientos.

phases.title: Clímax y cierre
phases.focus: Resolver el conflicto principal y completar el desenlace.

phases.title: Cierre del borrador
phases.focus: Completar escenas pendientes y guardar el primer borrador.

sessionTypes.title: Mapa de la aventura

blocks.activity: Anota la premisa y qué hace especial al protagonista.
Esboza el objetivo, los obstáculos y el destino.
Ordena cinco hitos posibles de la aventura.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una premisa y una lista de cinco hitos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Los hitos tienen un orden y conducen a un desenlace posible.

sessionTypes.title: Personajes en acción

blocks.activity: Define qué quiere el protagonista.
Crea un aliado y un rival con objetivos propios.
Escribe una breve escena donde sus objetivos choquen.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Fichas breves y una escena de conflicto.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Cada personaje toma una decisión que afecta la aventura.

sessionTypes.title: Escritura de escena

blocks.activity: Elige el objetivo y el obstáculo de la escena.
Escribe sin detenerte a corregir.
Anota qué cambia al final de la escena.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Una escena nueva para el borrador.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La escena tiene una acción, un obstáculo y un cambio.

sessionTypes.title: Tramo de escritura

blocks.activity: Relee la última nota de continuidad.
Escribe escenas consecutivas sin editar.
Deja una nota para retomar la historia.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Un tramo continuo de borrador.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Hay texto nuevo y una nota clara para la próxima sesión.

sessionTypes.title: Completar el desenlace

phases.title: Build a baseline
phases.focus: Practice core vocabulary, listening, and short spoken and written responses.

phases.title: Build fluency
phases.focus: Use new language in conversations and short texts; review recurring errors.

phases.title: Apply and review
phases.focus: Practice longer listening and speaking tasks, then refine clarity and accuracy.

phases.title: Show progress
phases.focus: Complete a short English task and review progress.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulary in context

blocks.activity: Recall words from the previous session.
Learn useful words and phrases around one everyday topic.
Write original sentences using the new language.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A list of 8 useful words or phrases with example sentences.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can recall the words and explain each example sentence.

sessionTypes.title: Focused listening

blocks.activity: Preview the topic and note what you expect to hear.
Listen to a short English audio or video and note key points.
Replay a section and check your notes against what you hear.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short summary with three details from the recording.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Your summary captures the main idea and three accurate details.

sessionTypes.title: Speaking practice

blocks.activity: Choose a familiar topic and jot down key words.
Speak about the topic, recording yourself or speaking with a partner.
Listen back or reflect, then repeat with clearer phrasing.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A one-minute spoken response and a note on one improvement.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the response and identify one phrase to improve.

sessionTypes.title: Short writing

blocks.activity: Choose a prompt and outline three points.
Write a short paragraph in English.
Review for clear meaning, sentence structure, and spelling.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A revised paragraph of 80 to 120 words.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The paragraph covers the prompt and has been checked once.

sessionTypes.title: Everyday conversation

blocks.activity: Prepare useful phrases for an everyday situation.
Role-play a conversation or discuss the topic with a partner.
Note useful phrases and one moment that was difficult.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief conversation record with five useful phrases.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the role-play and record five phrases you used or learned.

sessionTypes.title: Listen, respond, and write

blocks.activity: Listen to a short English recording and note its main points.
Give a spoken response summarizing or reacting to it.
Write a short response and check it for clarity.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Listening notes, a spoken response, and a short written response.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: All three responses address the recording's main idea.

phases.title: Encontrar un horario viable
phases.focus: Probar horarios frescos y establecer una rutina flexible.

phases.focus: Aumentar gradualmente el tiempo de carrera y mantener días de descanso.

phases.title: Mantener y revisar
phases.focus: Sostener el hábito y cerrar con una semana ligera.

sessionTypes.title: Trote suave

blocks.activity: Camina a paso cómodo.
Trota a ritmo fácil.
Camina para terminar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Anota el horario, la duración y cómo se sintió el esfuerzo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completas los 25 minutos a un ritmo que permite hablar.

sessionTypes.title: Carrera base

blocks.activity: Camina con paso ágil.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Registra el horario y los minutos corridos.

sessionTypes.title: Carrera larga fácil

phases.focus: Practicar conceptos clave y resolver ejercicios por tema.

phases.title: Integración y velocidad
phases.focus: Combinar temas y mejorar precisión y ritmo.

phases.title: Simulacros y corrección
phases.focus: Resolver pruebas cronometradas y corregir errores recurrentes.

phases.title: Repaso final
phases.focus: Consolidar fórmulas y estrategias con menor carga al final.

sessionTypes.title: Diagnóstico de matemáticas y física

blocks.activity: Resolver ejercicios variados de matemáticas.
Resolver ejercicios variados de física.
Anotar aciertos, dudas y errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de temas dominados y temas por reforzar.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Registraste resultados y clasificaste cada error.

sessionTypes.title: Fundamentos de matemáticas

blocks.activity: Repasar definiciones y ejemplos del libro.
Resolver ejercicios del tema elegido.
Corregir y explicar los errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Ejercicios resueltos y corregidos.

sessionTypes.title: Fundamentos de física

blocks.activity: Repasar conceptos y fórmulas del libro.
Resolver problemas del tema elegido.
Revisar unidades, procedimiento y resultado.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Problemas resueltos con procedimientos completos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Completaste al menos 6 problemas y verificaste sus unidades.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso activo

blocks.activity: Escribir de memoria fórmulas o conceptos estudiados.
Comprobarlos con el libro y completar lo que faltó.
Anotar tres puntos para repasar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Hoja de recuerdo y lista breve de dudas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Contrastaste tus respuestas con el libro y anotaste las dudas.

sessionTypes.title: Práctica mixta

blocks.activity: Resolver ejercicios alternados de matemáticas y física.
Revisar respuestas y localizar errores.
Registrar el tema que requiere más práctica.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Serie mixta resuelta con registro de errores.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Terminaste la serie y clasificaste los errores por tema.

sessionTypes.title: Simulacro cronometrado

blocks.activity: Resolver una selección de preguntas sin consultar el libro.
Corregir respuestas y registrar tiempo y errores.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Respuestas, puntuación y lista de errores del simulacro.

sessionTypes.title: Corrección de errores

blocks.activity: Elegir errores recientes y revisar el concepto relacionado.
Resolver de nuevo los ejercicios sin mirar la solución.
Escribir una regla para evitar repetir cada error.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Errores corregidos y reglas personales de revisión.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Resolviste de nuevo cada ejercicio y explicaste el procedimiento.

question: ¿Qué te gustaría explorar o mejorar para avanzar hacia un cambio de carrera?

phases.title: Fundamentos
phases.focus: Conocer principios de UX/UI y observar experiencias digitales.

phases.title: Investigación y estructura
phases.focus: Practicar investigación básica y organizar contenido y flujos.

phases.title: Diseño y prototipado
phases.focus: Crear pantallas, prototipos y probarlos con otras personas.

phases.title: Cierre y próximos pasos
phases.focus: Pulir un caso de estudio y definir cómo continuar aprendiendo.

sessionTypes.title: Principios de UX/UI

blocks.activity: Lee una introducción a UX y UI.
Anota cinco principios de diseño centrado en las personas.
Relaciona cada principio con un ejemplo digital.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de cinco principios con ejemplos.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes explicar cada principio con tus palabras.

sessionTypes.title: Análisis de una interfaz

blocks.activity: Elige una aplicación o sitio que uses.
Observa navegación, jerarquía visual y claridad.
Registra tres aciertos y tres oportunidades de mejora.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Ficha breve de análisis de interfaz.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: La ficha incluye observaciones concretas y justificadas.

phases.title: Start small
phases.focus: Make journaling easy to begin with short, repeatable entries.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Use simple prompts and a regular cue to keep the habit going.

phases.title: Make it yours
phases.focus: Practice flexible formats and recover smoothly after missed days.

phases.title: Keep it going
phases.focus: Choose a sustainable routine and reflect on what helped.

sessionTypes.title: Quick journal entry

blocks.activity: Settle in and write the date.
Write freely about one moment, thought, or feeling.
Underline one useful detail and close the entry.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One dated journal entry.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The entry is dated and contains at least three complete sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Prompted journal entry

blocks.activity: Choose a prompt: What stood out today? What did I learn? What do I need to remember?
Write a response without editing as you go.
Add a title and mark one sentence to keep.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One titled entry responding to a prompt.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The entry answers the prompt and includes one sentence worth keeping.

sessionTypes.title: Journal week review

blocks.activity: Look over this week's entries or note which days were blank.
Write about a recurring theme, a memorable moment, and what made writing easier.
Choose a cue and a simple prompt for the coming week.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short weekly reflection and a plan for the next week.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The reflection names one theme and the next week's cue and prompt.

sessionTypes.title: Flexible-format entry

blocks.activity: Choose a format: a list, a letter, or a few paragraphs.
Capture what is on your mind in the chosen format.
Date the entry and note what made this format useful.

sessionTypes.deliverable: One dated entry in a chosen format.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The entry is dated and the chosen format is clear.

sessionTypes.title: Restart after a gap

blocks.activity: Date the page and write, 'I am starting again today.'
Write about what is happening now; do not catch up on missed days.
Choose the next writing cue.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A fresh entry and one next-step cue.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The entry is dated and a specific cue for the next entry is written.

spec.title: Build a Consistent Japanese Study Routine

phases.title: Start small
phases.focus: Establish a repeatable study habit with short, focused sessions.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Add steady vocabulary, grammar, and listening practice.

phases.title: Make it sustainable
phases.focus: Keep a balanced routine and use Japanese in small practical tasks.

phases.title: Review and continue
phases.focus: Ease off, review progress, and choose a routine to carry forward.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulary review

blocks.activity: Review due flashcards.
Learn a small set of new words.
Recall the new words without prompts.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A reviewed and updated vocabulary list.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have reviewed due cards and recalled the new words once.

sessionTypes.title: Grammar practice

blocks.activity: Recall one previously studied grammar point.
Study one new grammar point with examples.
Write original sentences using it.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short set of original sentences using the grammar point.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You can explain the point simply and write three example sentences.

sessionTypes.title: Listening practice

blocks.activity: Preview the topic and listen for familiar words.
Listen to a short Japanese clip twice.
Note key words and one phrase to revisit.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief listening note with key words and one phrase.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have listened twice and recorded what you understood.

sessionTypes.title: Short reading practice

blocks.activity: Preview a short, level-appropriate text.
Read and mark unfamiliar words or patterns.
Summarize the text in a few simple notes.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short text with annotations and a brief summary.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have read the text and captured its main idea.

sessionTypes.title: Weekly review and plan

blocks.activity: Review notes and examples from this week.
Mark what felt easy and what needs another pass.
Choose specific sessions and materials for next week.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief progress note and next week's study plan.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have recorded one win, one review target, and the next study times.

sessionTypes.title: Speaking practice

blocks.activity: Review useful words and sentence patterns.
Speak aloud about a familiar topic in Japanese.
Record one attempt and note a phrase to improve.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short spoken recording and one improvement note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You have completed and saved one short speaking attempt.

phases.title: Build consistency
phases.focus: Use focused work blocks and track progress across regular study sessions.

phases.title: Strengthen independence
phases.focus: Plan sessions independently and recover focus when distractions arise.

phases.title: Review and sustain
phases.focus: Ease off, review what worked, and set a practical routine to continue.

sessionTypes.title: Focus setup and study

blocks.activity: Write one specific study goal and prepare the materials.
Study with notifications off and unrelated sites closed.
Record progress and note any distractions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A completed study task and a brief distraction log.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The goal is attempted for 20 focused minutes and progress is recorded.

sessionTypes.title: Focused study block

blocks.activity: Choose a concrete task and block distracting websites.
Work on the task without switching to unrelated online activity.
Take a screen-free break.
Summarize progress and choose the next step.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A visible piece of study progress and a next-step note.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: The study task receives 30 focused minutes and the next step is written down.

sessionTypes.title: Distraction recovery practice

blocks.activity: List likely online distractions and set a simple barrier.
Study; when distracted, note it and return to the task.
Review which barrier or reset helped.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A short record of distractions and useful reset strategies.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You complete the study block and identify one strategy to reuse.

sessionTypes.title: Study review and planning

blocks.activity: Review completed work and study notes from the week.
Identify when focus was strongest and what interrupted it.
Choose next week's study targets and schedule sessions.

sessionTypes.deliverable: A brief progress review and a study plan for the next week.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: You record one useful focus habit and schedule the next study sessions.

phases.title: Reactivar lo básico
phases.focus: Repasar saludos, presentaciones y frases cotidianas.

phases.title: Construir vocabulario
phases.focus: Aprender palabras frecuentes y comprender frases breves.

phases.title: Entender situaciones cotidianas
phases.focus: Practicar diálogos sencillos y captar su idea principal.

phases.title: Repasar y consolidar
phases.focus: Revisar lo aprendido con práctica breve y autónoma.

sessionTypes.title: Vocabulario esencial

blocks.activity: Repasa cinco palabras conocidas.
Aprende cinco palabras nuevas con ejemplos.
Di las palabras en voz alta sin mirar.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de diez palabras con su significado.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Puedes recordar al menos ocho palabras sin mirar.

sessionTypes.title: Frases para el día a día

blocks.activity: Lee cinco frases sencillas en inglés.
Identifica las palabras que ya conoces.
Practica las frases en voz alta.
Escribe dos frases propias usando el modelo.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Dos frases propias y cinco frases practicadas.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Lees las frases en voz alta y entiendes su idea general.

sessionTypes.title: Escucha breve

blocks.activity: Escucha un diálogo lento y breve.
Escucha de nuevo y anota palabras reconocidas.
Resume en español lo que entendiste.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Lista de palabras reconocidas y resumen del diálogo.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Anotas tres palabras y captas el tema general.

sessionTypes.title: Repaso activo

blocks.activity: Repasa tus tarjetas de vocabulario.
Responde preguntas sencillas en inglés.
Anota qué recuerdas y qué revisarás después.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Tarjetas repasadas y una nota de progreso.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Respondes cinco preguntas y eliges un tema para repasar.

sessionTypes.title: Diálogo guiado

blocks.activity: Lee un diálogo cotidiano corto.
Subraya expresiones y palabras conocidas.
Practica ambas partes en voz alta.
Cambia dos detalles para crear una variante.

sessionTypes.deliverable: Diálogo practicado y una variante propia.
sessionTypes.doneWhen: Representas el diálogo y entiendes su situación.
